Control a party of up to 5 immortals as you travel through a unique fantasy world, using spells and strategy to defeat your enemies. Play co-op, versus, or solo through a compelling campaign storyline with fully voiced characters.

games.title: Noch
games.description: Go alone (or with a friend) to find the girl who destroyed the world. An ominous surreal first-person adventure full of dangerous monsters and secrets of the deceased world

games.title: Mass Exodus Redux
games.description: Whether you’re playing the seeker (VR) or rogue android (PC), Mass Exodus is a tense and absorbing local multiplayer game. With 4 extensive maps each with unique kill methods and some creative power-ups, you need to try outsmart your friends anyway you can. Oculus Touch and HTC Vive compatible.

games.title: Epic Arena
games.description: Epic Arena is a free-to-play turn-based strategy game. Pick one of three completely different teams and outwit your opponent in epic back-and-forth matches. Flex your tactical muscles in time-limited Blitz mode matches or take your time in turn-by-turn duels.

games.title: ABC Coloring Town
games.description: ABC Coloring Town offers a creative playground for children and is a fun way to learn Basic English pronunciation and words. Explore and learn letters from the alphabet as you visit cute houses full of pretty pictures to paint.

games.title: Full Spectrum Warrior
games.description: The U.S. Army is the most powerful ground force in the entire world. The backbone of a ground invasion is the U.S. Army Infantry, and in the midst of combat, their skills, courage, and teamwork are put to the test. While readiness continues to be the U.S. Army's top priority, how it goes about its business is changing.

games.title: Road Scars: Origins
games.description: Ride day and night, taking on risky jobs for the Road Baron, avoiding traffic and other bikers on endless dangerous roads, all of that while you blast some original punk rock music!

games.title: Santa Rockstar Steam Edition
games.description: SAVE CHRISTMAS WITH THE POWER OF ROCK! Santa needs your help! Take your guitar and rock all around the world, delivering presents in the Merry Christmas Stage Sled with the help of the Reindeer Band. Test your skills in this amazing music game, with incredible rock versions of the best known Christmas Carols.

games.title: Dungeons - The Dark Lord
games.description: Dungeons: The Dark Lord is the sequel to Dungeons, the game where the more evil you are, the better! There are a slew of exciting new features, including four-player multiplayer in four modes!

games.title: Space Scavenger
games.description: Action roguelike where you build and command your own spaceships. Battle enemies, explore planets and customize your ship on the fly. Make the best use of the quirky ship modules you find, ranging from slingshots to ion cannons, to try and avoid certain death.

games.title: Hive
games.description: Officially licensed version of the "Mensa Select" award-winning board game! Hive is a board game with a difference. There is no board! The pieces are added to the playing area thus creating the board.

games.title: Post Master
games.description: Can you take control of a mail distribution company where your business will need to adapt to a growing city? Will you be able to handle the pressure of new delivery opportunities or are other delivery businesses step in to pick up the slack and impact your profit margin.

games.title: Maskmaker
games.description: In an all new mysterious universe built by the developers of the award-winning A Fisherman's Tale, you play as a Maskmaker's apprentice and learn the magic of crafting masks to immerse yourself in the intriguing enigmatic beings within the game.

games.title: Tribloos 2
games.description: The Tribloos 2 is the sequel to the best-selling time management game, The Tribloos.Trey's village is under threat once more. Before there was only one storm to worry about, now there have been many and Matilda the dragon is being tired out trying to blow them all away!Can You Help Trey Save His Island?

games.title: Hex Commander: Fantasy Heroes
games.description: Build an army and lead your heroes into battle in an epic fantasy strategy game. Hex Commander: Fantasy Heroes is a turn-based strategy game that will put you right in the middle of war between Humans, Orcs, Goblins, Elves, Dwarves and the undead.

games.title: Spire Horizon Online
games.description: Spire Horizon Online is an MMORPG where players become skeleton adventurers on a quest to find their capybara friend. Choose from a variety of classes, battle numerous monsters, and explore diverse regions.

games.title: The Huntsman: Winter's Curse
games.description: The Huntsman: Winter’s Curse is a narrative-driven, interactive fantasy fiction game with a card based combat system set in the universe of Snow White and the Huntsman.

games.title: Galaxy in Turmoil
games.description: Galaxy in Turmoil's conceptual Early Access game is a FREE multiplayer combined-arms game set in a brand-new universe, created by a team of volunteers. It’s all about endless arms races, corporate espionage, and, most of all, blasting up on the enemy faction and taking their stuff.

games.title: Metal Assault
games.description: Metal Assault is a free to play action packed 2D side scroller with rough 'em up, shoot 'em up fun! Grab some friends, grab a weapon and get in the thick of battle with defense specialist Carl, sharpshooter Marie, the brute force of Burton and tactical expert Ai!

games.title: Thorne - Death Merchants
games.description: Play as an infamous mercenary known as "The Crow" in a decayed and corrupt world, find your way out of chains and get paid for your contract, in this enthralling Action-RPG with high production values.

games.title: Krosmaster Arena
games.description: BECOME MASTER OF THE KROSMOZ! Challenge players over the world in a tactical board game of strategy and epic battles! Discover more than a hundred fighters and face down your enemies in ruthless battles.

games.title: Talisman: The Horus Heresy
games.description: Talisman: The Horus Heresy is a digital board game based on the Talisman rule system and set in the Warhammer 40,000 universe, during the cataclysmic events of the Horus Heresy.

games.title: Naval Warfare
games.description: As Commander of a Naval Super-Destroyer, wage war in a military campaign of epic proportions in, under and above the surface!

games.title: Regimental Chess
games.description: Regimental Chess is a battle game where large armies of chess pieces move and capture in mass formations. Up to 372 pieces in a single battle.

games.title: Star Trek Adversaries
games.description: Star Trek Adversaries is a free-to-play online collectible card video game set in the vast Star Trek universe. Collect ships and crew, battle your friends (and foes) across the galaxy, and engage in ranked play and tournaments.

games.title: The Captain
games.description: In this retro-inspired adventure game you will have to race back home across the galaxy. Collect new friends on your journey. Make new enemies. You won't be able to save everyone. Who will you leave behind? Which civilizations will you save - or destroy - along the way?

games.title: Deus Ex: Mankind DividedTM VR Experience
games.description: Discover four iconic environments from Deus Ex: Mankind Divided, for the first time in virtual reality.

games.title: Call of Duty: Black Ops - OSX
games.description: Call of Duty®: Black Ops Mac Edition will take you behind enemy lines as a member of an elite special forces unit engaging in covert warfare.

games.title: Fantasy Wars
games.description: Fantasy Wars is a turn-based strategy game set in a fantasy world. Combining both classic strategy gameplay and sophisticated 3D graphics players can experience epic battles like never before. Taking place in a fantasy world of Human kingdoms, Orc clans, Dwarfs' citadels and Elven forests the player is thrust into a world of war and...

games.title: Alien Hostage
games.description: Ready to give up? Ready to rage? In 'Alien Hostage' you must complete all challenges given to you by the human scientists who have trapped you on Earth.

games.title: Khan VS Kahn
games.description: Khan VS Kahn is a turn-based strategy game where two races compete over one city by achieving one of the 5 victory types Find out how to play and find the secret ending or challenge a friend in a 1v1 Duel. You can use your enemy's building, but be careful, he can use yours!

games.title: Secret Government
games.description: Global strategy game about secret societies. You’ll lead the Brotherhood - an organization that juggles the whole world. The key feature of the game is the manipulation of powers. Instead of giving direct orders, the Brotherhood provokes countries into doing what the Brothers want.

games.title: Void & Meddler
games.description: Fragments and details, rainy nights and blurry lights are all VOID&MEDDLER focuses on. A non-linear cyberpunk adventure where genders and species melt into each other.

games.title: Freedom Force vs. the 3rd Reich
games.description: Freedom is threatened yet again and only Minute Man and his heroic Freedom Force can save the day in the follow up to one of the most critically acclaimed games of 2002. Freedom Force vs. the Third Reich brings dynamic storytelling, fast-paced tactical role-play, and larger-than-life characters from the comic book pages to the computer...

games.title: STAR WARSTM X-Wing vs TIE Fighter: Balance of Power CampaignsTM
games.description: Real-time against real pilots; this is Star Wars space combat as it was meant to be! Featuring challenging real-time dogfights of 2 to 8 players, Star Wars™: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter is one of the most historically significant space combat simulators ever made.

games.title: This Book Is A Dungeon
games.description: Auto-cannibalism. Demonic Seduction. Occult Rituals. Bloodfeasting Worms. This dark, horrific Twine-based dungeon crawler pairs edgy interactive fiction with grisly pixel art and light RPG elements. Navigate this sprawling narrative-driven labyrinth bristling with otherworldly doom.

games.title: InCell VR
games.description: Race inside a human cell in this free arcade adventure. Dodge obstacles, collect proteins and speed boosts, and choose your route between organelles to reach the nucleus before a virus does. Steer with your head in VR, or play on a regular screen.

games.title: The Political Machine
games.description: Do you have what it takes to be president?Play as more than 20 candidates including Barack Obama, Mitt Romney, Rick Santorum, Ron Paul, Newt Gingrich or create your own candidate from scratch.Players take to the campaign trail against a computer controlled opponent or a human challenger over the Internet.

games.title: 炎黄战纪[Legacy of YanHuang]
games.description: 《炎黄战纪》是一款开放式的水墨历史风集换式卡牌游戏。 我们设计这款游戏的初衷对华夏五千年来那一个个青史留痕的人物的向往和致敬，希望能记录和纪念这些炎黄之魂以及他们的故事，同时也希望能提供一个平台将同好者们聚在一起来共同开发和完善这个游戏，青梅煮酒，共论天下英雄，评说功过是非。

games.title: Pharaonic
games.description: Embark on a journey of exploration and violence in the Two Lands of Egypt with Pharaonic! This unforgiving Combat RPG features an streamlined and challenging combat system that will keep you on your toes while fighting for your life!

games.title: NightCry
games.description: NightCry is set on a cruise ship, and you have been invited along for the cruise of a (possibly short) lifetime. While your surroundings are luxurious and the guests are friendly, not everything is as it should be. The guests and the crew start to turn up dead, the victims of some foul murderer.

games.title: Day D: Tower Rush
games.description: Onwards to the past! Learn the real power of science! Help the professor and his loyal companion deal with hordes of dinosaurs.

games.title: 机退怪兽
games.description: 指挥官，你将指挥人类最后的钢铁机甲来击退怪兽洪流！《机退怪兽》是一款以微操驱动的硬核塔防游戏。以手控操作的射击以及技能释放来适应防御阵型以及敌人配置的不断变化。

games.title: Chosen 2
games.description: Chosen 2 is a heroic RPG sequel to Chosen.

games.title: VR Benchmark Kanojo
games.description: [VR Benchmark from VRKanojo]It is a benchmark for VR. Let's measure the performance of your PC!It has a function that can become a fan in extra mode.

games.title: Grimind
games.description: Grimind is a 2D, physics based, adventure, platform game in horror/creepy theme. Grimind casts you into forgotten caves and ancient crypts, without memories. While being there you have to demonstrate great manual skills to pass obstacles and solve non trivial puzzles to get out of scary environment and additionally discover what are you...

games.title: Heroes of Steel RPG
games.description: Heroes of Steel is a tactical RPG set in a grim post-apocalyptic fantasy world. Coordinate your party of four heroes in turn-based combat and navigate a engaging world and story.

games.title: Oldage
games.description: Oldage is a free to play competitive turn based game inspired by Chess

games.title: NS2: Combat
games.description: NS2: Combat is a powerful twitch-shooter where space marines battle aliens through a competitive mixture of MOBA & FPS playstyles. Are you ready?

games.title: The Lost Souls
games.description: What does it feel like to find yourself in hell? You don't feel the wind, you don't see the sun. No more hearing child's laughter. No memory of those who once were your friends and family.

games.title: Help
games.description: Your daughter was gone at a research of the abandoned bunker. Having gone to find her, you meet the horrors living in these walls, solve puzzles, discover what has happened in this place and to find the daughter. Everything that you have, is a lamp which charge constantly decreases also the radio.

games.title: A Wild Catgirl Appears!
games.description: A Wild Catgirl Appears is a short romance visual novel featuring multiple routes, different girls to date and of course, catgirls! You follow the story of Ami, a loner at high school, as she joins the school's coding club and sets about making her first video game.

games.title: Farlanders: Prologue
games.description: Prepare for your journey to Mars by building and managing a colony within the safety of Earth’s atmosphere. Hone your abilities to create a thriving community, terraform the land to suit your needs, and prove your capability for a larger mission. Get ready to launch in this prologue to Farlanders.

games.title: Sunset Rangers
games.description: Experience the American Frontier as you traverse through unique landscapes, surviving unforgiving deserts and malevolent enemies along the way. Build a custom character, complete quests, collect and craft materials, build bases and take down enemies.

games.title: One More Line
games.description: ONE MORE LINE is a highly addictive, one button, space disco, skill timing game! Steam edition features 2-4 player local multi-player and no advertising. All for a very low price! Can you put a price on fun though?

games.title: No Sun To Worship
games.description: A short, minimalist stealth-action game about the importance of art. We painted the sky ashen gray. Burned the heavens to starve each other. Now we walk an endless cemetery of regret.

games.title: Bad Day
games.description: Bad Day - an endless runner with unique combination of 2D graphics and 3D environment. Compete with players from all around the world. But do not forget that the difficulty increases as you progress through.

games.title: Everland (Stress Test)
games.description: Social online world releasing in 2020 — hoping to help people find friendship and a sense of community.

games.title: NAM
games.description: You are Alan 'The Bear' Westmoreland, Marine Corps sergeant. The trouble starts on a deadly Viet Cong raid. Here the jungle is your battleground. Your mission, survive.

games.title: PIXELMAN
games.description: PIXELMAN is a retro styled, action-filled, high-score chaser arcade game, where you control the title character in his mission to rescue the citizens of Pixville from the evil Baron Von Pixel and his contraptions.

games.title: Z Steel Soldiers
games.description: In the bloody aftermath of ‘Z’ comes The Bitmap Brothers classic, “Z Steel Soldiers”: a new breed of robot with a taste for war and a warped sense of humour.

games.title: Engine Evolution
games.description: Engine Evolution is a multiplayer racing game that uses similar principles as World of Tanks. With each PvP race against 11 other players, you gain experience and credits, for which you can buy various upgrades for your bike or unlock the next bike.

games.title: Shadows 2: Perfidia
games.description: Shadows 2: Perfidia is a survival horror game inspired by classics like the Penumbra series and Layers of Fear. Explore a darkened office complex and uncover the truth behind the horrifying events that have befallen its inhabitants.

games.title: Wizardry 7: Crusaders of the Dark Savant
games.description: For the First TimeOutdoor CampaignsFull Soundtrack and EffectsTrue Point & Click Mouse InterfaceAuto-MappingUnprecedented Depth of StoryBegin your adventure in Crusaders of the Dark Savant. Import your characters from Bane of the Cosmic Forge or create a new party capable of surviving the rigors of a strange alien world.

games.title: Ereban: Shadow Legacy
games.description: Ereban: Shadow Legacy is a fast-paced stealth platformer game where you become Ayana, the last descendant of a forgotten race. Harness mystical shadow powers, high-tech gadgets and avoid or kill to uncover the truth about your past and the key to saving a dying, morally grey universe.

games.title: The Highrise
games.description: THE HIGHRISE is a first-person survival game set in a high-rise building that has been sealed off by an alien monster invasion. Gather resources to make fighting weapons and survival tools. You must find and send a rescue signal at the end of your desperate survival.

games.title: Cybercube
games.description: Cyberсube is a fast-paced action platformer where you take control of a cube and overcome increasingly difficult challenges.

games.title: Koala Kids
games.description: Koala Kids is a puzzle-platformer game, in the style of retro games like Lode Runner. Includes Hot-seat Coop and Level Editor.

games.title: Monsters' Den: Book of Dread
games.description: Enter the Monsters' Den, a place of endless adventure, battle and reward! Lead your party of four heroes through each level of the ever-changing dungeon, fighting in turn-based battles and hunting for that elusive rare loot. The web-game classic comes to Steam!

games.title: LocoSoccer Classic
games.description: LocoSoccer is a fun, crazy physics-based soccer game where you must do a lot of goals to win cups and accesories for your team. Your objective is easy: win all cups with your goals. How awesome is that?

games.title: Montecrypto: The Bitcoin Enigma
games.description: Be the first to solve the enigmas of Montecrypto! Leave hints along the way or slow others down by leading them to dead-ends, the choice is yours.

games.title: Heroes Tactics
games.description: The world’s most addictive tactical strategy & defense game – welcome to Heroes Tactics! You’ll need some brains and tactics to lead your unique team of knights, archers, magicians, riders, flyers, and other types of awesome heroes!

games.title: CT Special Forces: Fire for Effect
games.description: CT Special Forces: Fire For Effect will feature unique missions in the fight against worldwide terrorist networks. The game also benefits from a cutting-edge engine as well as a specific physics system. For the first time in this genre, physics will have a major impact on how you play the game.

games.title: Laraan
games.description: Laraan is a Science-Fiction game about exploration in a desolate world. Created with a minimalist low poly style. Accompanied by a splendid movie soundtrack.

games.title: Curse of Mermos
games.description: Curse of Mermos is a free, lighthearted hack and slash game with fast paced action and challenging combat. Players wield the Hammer of Horus or shoot the Crossbow of Neith to defeat hordes of monsters in the tomb of Ebo. The game features unlock-able abilities and skill upgrades for personalized combat.

games.title: Rocket of Whispers: Prologue
games.description: In a chilling cellar below the apocalyptic snow, Fei Lin the witch wakes up from hibernation, and ventures into the forsaken world. Guide her through the process of escaping the cellar, and seeing the changed world for her first time.

games.title: DRAKERZ-Confrontation
games.description: The Trading Card Game in Augmented Reality.

games.title: Metamorfose S
games.description: Metamorfose S is a 2D action-adventure game with RPG elements.

games.title: Sinking Island
games.description: Walter Jones, a billionaire had planned on opening up a resort for the rich and famous, but was killed before his dream could be achieved. It's up to Detective Jack Norm to crack the case by interviewing the people on Sinking Island to get valuable clues. A game from Benoit Sokal.

games.title: Power-Up
games.description: A fast-paced retro shoot-'em-up featuring evolving weapons, intense arcade combat and massive bosses — from one-man studio Psychotic Psoftware.

games.title: 封神榜2023
games.description: This game takes Nezha, Xiaolongnv, Yang Jian and Jiang Ziya as the protagonists. The game tells the legendary story of the protagonists going to various places to adventure, and finally to Zhaoge City to destroy the three demons and defeat King Zhou.

games.title: Make It Rain: Love of Money
games.description: Make it Rain: The Love of The Money is a swiper game, where you have to invest your money in the best way to get richer then get more richer and then be very very rich. Be a business manager and success in your investments! Or otherwise, die in the process and start again to amass a lot of cash!

games.title: Oracle
games.description: ORACLE is a single player, open world experience with dozens of locations to explore, great soundtrack and an awesome story ready to be unraveled.

games.title: Victoria: Revolutions
games.description: Carefully guide your nation from the era of absolute monarchies in the early 19th century, through expansion, colonization and social upheaval, to emerge as one of the great world powers by the dawn of the 20th century in Victoria Complete.

games.title: Castle Craft
games.description: Will your castle survive the relentless onslaught, or collapse under pressure? Build, manage resources, and outsmart your foes in a world where everything can be destroyed. Use strategy and creativity to turn the chaos into your greatest advantage!

games.title: 3DRPG
games.description: 3DRPG is a voxelized old-school RPG where you explore a Randomly Generated world filled with random dungeons, towns and people! Every character in the game is recruitable. Hunt for prey or go fishing for food. Search for treasure in dungeons and fight monsters on the way!

games.title: Crazy Machines 2
games.description: Crazy Machines 2 is packed with all new features to help you create your wackiest "Rube Goldberg-style" contraptions yet! All new elements, plus an amazing 3D physics engine lets you craft even more complex gadgets and effects.

games.title: Life Eater
games.description: If you don't sacrifice your neighbors, the world ends. Life Eater is a horror fantasy kidnapping simulator where you must become intimately familiar with your targets' lives one intrusive action at a time... and hope that the dark god you serve is even real.

games.title: The Last Spell: Prologue
games.description: Experience the first five days of The Last Spell. Lead a team of hardened heroes to defend the last bastion of humanity against hordes of monsters in this turn-based tactical RPG immersed in roguelite mechanics.

games.title: CLASH
games.description: Clash is a hard-core action/rpg arena blend. With a wide variety of skills to mix and match that inspires creativity and unique styles, Clash lives up to its goal as an action game for the brainy. Play multiplayer with friends or compete in the single-player league by making your way up the leader-board.

games.title: Orbox C
games.description: Bounce the box in outer space. Blow bombs, break the ice, collect orbs, activate sensors and more! The game starts easy and slowly grows in difficulty to the real challenge. When you want a clever brain teaser for 5-20 min session - this is the best choice.

games.title: The Guild II - Pirates of the European Seas
games.description: The first true life simulation series set in the fascinating medieval Europe! The Addon expands and transforms the game into an even greater experience by adding a huge area including the cities of "The Hanse" located at the shores of the European seas.

games.title: Grizzly Valley
games.description: The Grizzly bear is one of the greatest wild animals in North America. The number of fatal human attacks is actually low. They do not naturally hunt people to eat. However...

games.title: Light Fairytale Episode 1
games.description: A turn-based JRPG series with a modern presentation and classic heart. Episode 1 is the start of the adventure. Play as Haru and his childhood friend Kuroko as they defy an evil empire in the underground 'Lower City'.

games.title: Wanderlust Adventures
games.description: Wanderlust Adventures is an online, free-roaming, open world, action adventure RPG. Join fellow heroes online, explore vast and deadly landscapes, and capture companions to aid you in your quest. Forge powerful items, salvage artifacts, and crush the souls of menacing foes!

games.title: Medieval Defenders
games.description: Defend your ancestral castle – show the invader who the master is! Build towers, save money, train your spells, and your enemy will be vanquished.

games.title: Myst V
games.description: The Grand Finale of the greatest adventure! Decide the fate of a civilization in this triumphant final chapter to the Myst saga. Embark on an epic journey into the heart of a shattered empire as the only explorer who can still save it— or destroy it with the wrong choices.

games.title: Forbidden Ingress
games.description: Our world is in danger! Grab your gun and stop these uninvited guests!

games.title: Game Tycoon 2
games.description: In Game Tycoon 2 you find yourself in the middle of the big players. Get into the act and experience the fascination of the game development. Reach your goal and become the Game Tycoon!

games.title: Polterheist
games.description: You are a burglar, and you often rob houses at night when the owners are out.

games.title: UFO: Extraterrestrials Gold
games.description: UFO: Extraterrestrials GOLD is a new GOLD edition which includes a number of changes and improvements giving a player a new look on the classic game: new maps, possibility to hire soldiers, globe UFO swarms and configurability.

games.title: Soul Axiom
games.description: From the studio that brought you Master Reboot comes a first-person story-driven adventure puzzle game, set in the beautiful, haunting cyber-world of Elysia. Collect unique hand powers, discover multiple endings and choose your own destiny as you unravel the mystery of your digital afterlife.

games.title: Chaos Combat Chess
games.description: Welcome to Chaos Combat Chess, a competitive 8v8 auto chess battle royale!

games.title: Divided We Fall
games.description: Unite and fight your way to victory! Divided we Fall is a strategic close-combat multiplayer game that emphasizes the importance of building an effective cohesive squad and executing well thought-out tactics on the battlefield.

games.title: Trip to Vinelands
games.description: Trip to Vinelands is an arcade retro hardcore maze wanderer minigame.

games.title: Cooking Witch
games.description: In Cooking Witch you are a witch flying to a party in the woods, abducting the children and cooking and eating them.

games.title: The Dark Stone from Mebara
games.description: Set in 1924 Massachusetts, take the role of Detective Monroe, Professor Webley, and Boss Pendleton of the Pendleton Agency, all of whom have come to possess an eerie black rock with strange properties.

games.title: Wrath of Anna
games.description: You've been stranded on Empress Anna's remote planet of Drumgore during the Cross-Planetary War of 2021. How long can you survive?

games.title: Gaia Beyond
games.description: Gaia Beyond is a handcrafted 2D Action-RPG, an exploration mix built around the core features fighting, mining and trading. Your decisions are footprints within a vast non-linear solar system. Forge alliances among numerous factions and develop relations with hundreds of NPCs.

games.title: The 7th Guest: 25th Anniversary Edition
games.description: The famous game remastered in a new 25th Anniversary Edition! The father and mother of all 'Haunted Mansion' games. Winner of multiple gaming awards and “No. 1 Rated Game of 1994”.

games.title: Fadeout: Underground
games.description: Fadeout: Underground is a classic-style Third-Person online multiplayer shooter.

games.title: LOGistICAL
games.description: LOGistICAL is a strategy puzzle game where you transport different cargoes to complete all the towns throughout the country. The whole game is a huge puzzle while each town is its own little piece of puzzling. Plenty of towns are easy enough. LOGistICAL covers all of Australia.

games.title: Mainland
games.description: A text adventure game about a 19th century explorer who finds himself stranded and alone.

games.title: Zzzz-Zzzz-Zzzz
games.description: When you sleep, you are dreaming. Some dreams are beautiful and vivid, the others are strange, and the rest of them are horrible... We've having them all the night, and then wake up and forget them. But what if one day your "awakening" would be a difficult task? Could you find a way out of the dreams and wake up?

games.title: DayBreak Online
games.description: Imagine você, um Mago com plenos poderes para manipular o fogo, o gelo e a eletricidade, forças que podem levá-lo a derrotar seus inimigos, numa batalha inserida em uma história envolvente. Isso é possível em DayBreak Online.

games.title: Industry Empire
games.description: An entire industrial empire under your control. Have you always dreamed of swimming in money? In “Industry Empire” you are the boss of all bosses.

games.title: Crusader Kings Complete
games.description: Europe is in turmoil. The lands are fragmented into petty fiefs and the Emperor struggles with the Pope. At this very moment the Pope has declared that those who go to liberate the Holy Land will be freed of all sins. Gather prestige and piety and the world will whisper your name in awe.

games.title: Fancy Skiing VR
games.description: Fancy Skiing is developed by HashVR Studio built with the Unity Engine.The game's structure is based on real skiing that players use the handles just as ski poles to get power and lean left or right to control the direction, which brings players a strong immersion.

games.title: The Land Beneath Us
games.description: A fast-paced, turn-based rogue-lite dungeon crawler. Unleash skill combos, wield a variety of weapons and battle through the mythic Underworld of Annwn. Conquer the 7 Lords, collect Soul-Tech, and save The Creator. With real-time tactical decisions and endless replayability, runs are never the same!

games.title: Heroes of Havoc
games.description: Welcome to Heroes of Havoc, the RPG that combines clicker controls with amazing 3D graphics! Sending your heroes into battle couldn’t be simpler. Give the command and your epic party will march into combat, slaying monsters, earning XP and collecting loot while you upgrade heroes and reap rewards.

games.title: Destroy All Humans! Clone Carnage
games.description: Wreak havoc in Clone Carnage! This standalone DLC comes with 4 modes, 6 maps, and up to 4-player multiplayer. Split-screen lets you double the damage in local 2-player multiplayer. Unleash your wild side in Rampage, Armageddon, Race, and Abduction modes!

games.title: Germ Wars
games.description: Take control of a determined White Blood Cell on a quest for self discovery, vengeance, punishment and annihilation of all evil germs who would dare infiltrate an unsuspecting and innocent human body in this unique and organic experience.

games.title: Orpheus's Dream
games.description: Orpheus’s Dream is a 3D isometric-inspired puzzle game with storytelling elements. Explore an amnesiac’s family house and recover lost memories of him and his cat.

games.title: Portal Fantasy
games.description: Journey through an epic storyline, collecting creatures to aid you in turn-based battles, avoiding traps and solving puzzles, completing thrilling quests, and uncovering the darker history of Pyli Kingdom in this RPG with a unique modern take on a classic beloved genre.

games.title: El Dorado: The Golden City Builder - Prologue
games.description: The Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full version of the game. El Dorado - Prologue is a strategy city-building game in which you plan, build and develop your settlement to conquer Jukatan and earn the title of The Golden City. Become a leader, whom even Gods will bow to.

games.title: Epic Manager
games.description: Epic Manager is a unique crossover between Sports Management and classic JRPGs. Experience an addictive “one more turn” mix of tycoon strategy, roguelike elements, roster management, combat and character progression, all rooted in an epic yet light-hearted fantasy setting. Rated ‘E’ for EPIC!

games.title: UFO: Aftershock
games.description: UFO: Aftershock is a combination of tactical squad combat and global strategy that enhances and expands upon its prequel, UFO: Aftermath.

games.title: Causality
games.description: Causality is a survival horror game. You must rescue 3 students trapped in a school full of mysterious psychic phenomena, and uncover the secrets behind therein. The real story behind the school, and the causal relationship of the events, is all in your hands.

games.title: Tidalis
games.description: Tidalis is a block-based puzzle game with casual appeal, hardcore depth, and an addictive new "streams" mechanic. The game is brimming over with riffs and variants on that core mechanic with 20 game modes, dozens of special blocks and items, and 115 levels in the adventure mode alone.

games.title: Heroes of Hellas 3: Athens
games.description: Rebuild Athens from the ashes of its destruction and secure the help of the Heroes of Olympus as you battle an evil god!

games.title: The Lady
games.description: "The Lady" is a 2D Surreal Puzzle Horror, featuring hand drawn character art, stop motion animation, and a hauntingly abrasive Noisecore Soundtrack. The game features the most unique female protagonist to ever exist in a video game.

games.title: Exodus from the Earth
games.description: The Intelligence Agency has commissioned you, Francis Rixon, to find out what is happening inside the Corporation's confines and to retrieve information about a secret mineral upon which the very existence of the human race may depend.

games.title: Spellwake
games.description: Spellwake is an online 3D Action RPG where Anything Goes. It features fast-paced hack n' slash against hordes of monsters and powerful bosses. Spellwake's vast class system allows you to make nearly infinite variations of builds.

games.title: Phantom Project
games.description: Phantom Project is a psychological horror game that encourages you to put your deerstalker on and unravel the supernatural mysteries around you. This game is a prototype and is subject to major changes and improvements.

games.title: Chronicles of the Witches and Warlocks
games.description: To free her beloved, the lawyer Kathleen Wilson has to hold her own investigation. She’ll have to solve a plethora of puzzles before she can learn what really happened.

games.title: Flotilla
games.description: Lead your orbital battleships to victory in Flotilla! Fight, trade, and explore new planets in your journey through the galaxy. Featuring tactically rich 3D combat, flank and surprise the enemy from any direction. When the dust settles, generate another randomized universe for a brand new adventure!

games.title: Cyberline Racing
games.description: Cyberline Racing combines action packed shooting with adrenaline pumped races, delivering an explosive experience. Load your car with guns and put your driving skills to the ultimate test as you dodge missiles, destroy enemy cars, and race to the top of the online rankings!

games.title: Ingnomia
games.description: Following in the footsteps of Dwarf Fortress and Gnomoria, this game aims to provide the best experience of both worlds. The graphics and accessibility of Gnomoria and the depth and rich content of Dwarf Fortress.

games.title: iO
games.description: iO is an abstract physics platformer about size and speed. Grow bigger and smaller in order to solve some of the trickiest puzzles. Reach the exit as quickly as possible and grab a gold medal as your reward!

games.title: GO AWAY, THERE'S KUMIS OVER THERE!
games.description: This arcade runner is about a horse and our favorite drink - kumis! Collect cookies, pick up items like multipliers, bombs, HPs and try to get as high score as you can. Cookies are your best friends in that game!

games.title: Mechajammer
games.description: A tactical cyberpunk turn-based RPG set on an off-world grindhouse jungle colony. Skulk through the shadows or charge in guns blazing. Recruit a unique party for large squad-based assaults as your adventure plunges you deep into the city’s secrets.

games.title: Abrix the robot
games.description: Abrix 2 is an addictive puzzle game for everyone. Try over 170 different levels of puzzles and secrets and help Abrix, a tiny toy robot, to find a way out. Abrix 2 is a continuation of a hit game Abrix the robot. Now with new graphics and full of new stuff it's better than ever.

games.title: Girlfriend Rescue
games.description: Girlfriend Rescue is a thrilling adventure where the gameplay of "Dragon Quest" meets the atmosphere of "Streets of Rage". Innovative, mixing rogue-style RPG and Beat'em Up atmosphere in a unique way, this game features a great deal of strategy through a mix of character selection & creative skills.

games.title: ISOLAND3: Dust of the Universe
games.description: A sequel to the ISOLAND series, where you continue your journey to explore the story of the universe on this island.

games.title: POBEDA
games.description: Representative of the genre Shoot 'em up, performed in the style of retro games. In the game you have to take control of the crew of the KV-2. On the battlefield you will fight with tanks E-100, Tiger II, PzKpfw IV.

games.title: Citalis
games.description: Citalis is a fast paced city simulation game where you must carefully manage your city to avoid crime and disasters such as floods and droughts - all whilst making a profit!

games.title: Of Bird And Cage
games.description: Of Bird and Cage is a unique metal album presented through a two-hour-long story-driven game. Play music in a brand-new way. Featuring famous artists like Ron "Bumblefoot" Thal (ex-Guns N' Roses), Rob van der Loo (Epica), Ruud Jolie (Within Temptation), and many others!

games.title: BREACH IT
games.description: "BREACH IT" is tactical multiplayer attack - defend type shooter. As an attacker destroy walls, doors with C4, hammers or tons of bullets to get to the enemy from an angle they would not expect. If you're on defending team, then it's time to get to work! Board doors, reinforce walls and get to position!

games.title: Zolg
games.description: Zolg is a minimalist top-down shooter where you explore, fight enemies, collect powerups, and defeat bosses.

games.title: Etherlords
games.description: Four races of wizards, adepts of four magical schools, collide in a brutal fight for world domination. Etherlords, an iconic strategy created by Nival, became a bestseller in the world and earned highest grades from critics.Etherlords is an exciting mix of turn-based strategy and fantasy trading card game.

games.title: Archean
games.description: Gather resources, craft components, build vehicles, and code their logic in a physics-driven engineering sandbox and full scale space sim.

games.title: Cyber City 2157: The Visual Novel
games.description: Feel the mysterious world of Molds and the City where the sun never sets. Look for clues, make decisions and follow your own path in the Cyber ​​City 2157.

games.title: Nevrosa: Prelude
games.description: You wake up in a strange, but yet familiar place. You feel like you are supposed to be here for something.VR roomscale puzzle-horror game with redirect walking locomotion.

games.title: Aerial Destruction
games.description: Take off your helicopter and unleash destruction on the armed groups of bio-engineered mutants through various missions and environments !

games.title: Blocks
games.description: Blocks lets you easily create 3D objects in virtual reality, no matter your modelling experience. Using six simple tools, you can bring your applications to life, create a volumetric masterpiece, or simply let your imagination run wild.

games.title: 東方翠神廻廊 〜 Faith in the Goddess of Suwa.
games.description: “Touhou Suijin Kairou” is a Touhou derivative RPG featuring over 150 fantasy girls! Explore the corridors and solve the strange situation in Gensokyo! A profound story unfolds, and your choices will change the future!

games.title: Hot Tin Roof: The Cat That Wore A Fedora
games.description: You’re the Private Investigator on a string of grisly murders, scouring for clues in a 3D side-scrolling world. Grab your fedora and revolver - in Hot Tin Roof you’re on the case! Dive into a noir mystery and become Emma Jones, the only PI partnered to a cat named Franky.

games.title: SkyTime
games.description: SkyTime is a 3D platformer in which you slow time, dodge bullets, destroy turrets and overcome obstacles! If you ever played Superhot or Cluster Truck, this game combines them both!

games.title: Frisky Business
games.description: You are Mr. Falco Frisk, private detective of Frisk Investigative Solutions! Develop your relationships with your team as you take on your very first case. Dive into a sexy and strange adventure of hot babes and killer clowns!

games.title: Data Hacker: Reboot
games.description: Time, Space and Parallel Universes collapse and merge, tethered to threads of reality and sustained by a paradoxical power source. Nothing is impossible - it is time to become a Data Hacker.

games.title: Mahjong World Contest
games.description: Join a Mahjong contest. Complete over 100 unique levels to gain experience and points. Improve your rank and progress.

games.title: USC: Counterforce
games.description: Lead your Space Commandos in a revival of turn-based squad tactics inspired by UFO/XCOM and Aliens. Utilize in-depth skill & combat systems in multiple game modes, including a full campaign. Discover the truth behind the demise of colony MC83-A and join the USC in defending humanity!

games.title: Astro Lords
games.description: Player bases are located on asteroids, which travel within the Oort Cloud. Once they’ve acquired the appropriate skills, players can control their asteroid’s movements. Mass-combat enthusiasts will love the Arena: here, players can battle it out against alien races or other Astro Lord players.

games.title: Shutter
games.description: Re-live a dark and haunting tale in this fixed camera puzzle-horror game RE-miniscent of the first generation of survival horror games.

games.title: Vendir: Plague of Lies
games.description: Vendir: Plague of Lies is a classic party-based RPG with a deep storyline and turn-based combat. Experience an intricately crafted world, steeped in history and brought to life through a carefully crafted atmosphere and the trials and tribulations of stories of the people that inhabit it.

games.title: Wolflord - Werewolf Online
games.description: Is your friend a bloodthirsty werewolf? Is your neighbor a demon from the eternal abyss? Band together in the small town and unmask the evil characters before everything is lost.

games.title: BATTLESHIP APOLLO
games.description: Experience epic, fast, truly tactical space combat against other players.

games.title: Family curse
games.description: Family curse is a mystical horror from the first person with a frightening atmosphere. Immerse yourself in the intricate history of the Crouse family and find out the terrible secret of the people who died in the cursed house.

games.title: Beneath the Mountain
games.description: In Beneath the Mountain, you play as the King of a new Dwarven civilization seeking to find their fortune beneath the mountain. You dig your way through the mountain, encountering many dangerous foes along the way, all while defending your kingdom from periodic Orc invasions.

games.title: Reversion - The Meeting
games.description: You’ve escaped the guarded hospital holding you prisoner to find Buenos Aires in ruins. Memories still missing, you must beat puzzles and collect clues to find a mysterious stranger who may hold the truth to what happened 20 years ago.

games.title: Solitaire
games.description: The classic card game is back in a digital version that everyone can play! Enjoy a quick game or chase after points to climb up the world rankings. 4 different settings and 3 popular game modes. Quite simply, Solitaire.

games.title: StarFringe: Adversus
games.description: This is the story about the beginning of the conquest of outer space by earthlings. It began as a global idea of saving mankind from hunger and lack of resources, and ended as a brutal and merciless war in space far from Earth.

games.title: Stonerid
games.description: Stonerid is a challenging 2D platformer, which the most important feature are two parallel, different worlds. Over 30 different levels to complete, unconventional game style and lots of dangerous traps and monsters make it extremely difficult to rise to the challenge.

games.title: X-COM: Interceptor
games.description: They're back...only this time the heinous aliens are out to destroy Earth and rule the new frontier. As X-COM commander, it's your sole duty to protect humanity and the prized mining operations in outer space.

games.title: Tales of Destruction
games.description: Tales of Destruction is Steam's newest FPS game fresh from Greenlight. TOD currently comes with 9 maps + 1 Open World and 2 weapons. You will be tasked to complete each map. There is pick-ups like ammo & health kits. Challenge yourself now with TOD

games.title: COLINA: Legacy
games.description: Alex wakes up at his grandmother’s, left alone in a silent house. Unsure where his family is, he begins to uncover a dark mystery in an attempt to escape. Facing his fear in an endless nightmare, Alex must survive the dead of night, a cursed forest, and paranormal activities before daylight arrives.

games.title: Earthtongue
games.description: Care for a miniature ecosystem in a strange world, exert limited influence to encourage the growth of different fungi and bugs and try to maintain the balance of life.

games.title: Mechanic Miner
games.description: Put your mechanical skills to the test in a physics-based sandbox where ingenuity and creativity are the ultimate key to survival. Construct fantastical machines, gather resources, acquire new technologies to battle dangerous enemies and use your imagination to shape your world.

games.title: Smelter
games.description: You are Eve, fresh out of Eden and armed with a living suit of armor, Smelter. Explore a dangerous new world, battle its bizarre denizens and expand your empire in a desperate journey to find Adam.

games.title: Alan's Automaton Workshop
games.description: Alan's Automaton Workshop is an open-ended programming puzzle game. Start a new business with Alan Turing and his groundbreaking innovation: the Turing Machine. Build unique automatons, and solve all kinds of problems from clients.

games.title: The Treasures of Montezuma 5
games.description: A thrilling gem-matching adventure awaits those who dare to explore the jungle of the Aztecs, where untold treasure lies hidden deep within an ancient temple!

games.title: BitMaster
games.description: BitMaster is a dynamic and colorful twin-stick shooter which design was inspired by such games as Geometry Wars, Crimson Land and Satellite Reign. Game powered by Unreal Engine 4!

games.title: The Sin
games.description: The depressing pictures of a dying village and its inhabitants to the dark ambient music of the underground performers make those who are still trying to survive in places where everything has long died, to plunge even deeper into the world of mystical horror and deep despair

games.title: ECO HOLE
games.description: ECO HOLE is a survival game for one or two players with unique gameplay. Strange events began to happen in the world, and people began to turn into monsters. You are mysterious heroes who suddenly appeared at the right moment, and you strive to stop the nightmare at any cost.

games.title: Avadon 2: The Corruption
games.description: Avadon 2: The Corruption is a huge, indie fantasy role-playing adventure, the second chapter in the epic Avadon trilogy. You will serve the keep of Avadon, working as a spy and warrior to fight the enemies of your homeland. As a servant of the Black Fortress, your word is law.

games.title: Beacon
games.description: Mutate yourself to victory as you scavenge an uncharted alien planet in this stylish sci-fi action rogue-like. With the help of your Clone Bay death isn't the ending, just another chance to find your Beacon.

games.title: Fox & Flock
games.description: There is a Fox in the ballroom! Or so the whispers from the other ballroom dancers suggest. Can the Flock trap the Fox before it is too late? Or will the Fox systematically eat all the other dancers before they even realize he is in their midst?

games.title: KILLRUN
games.description: Run n' gun parkour speedrunner. Race to set the best times and create the fastest routes. Smash the pro times on every level and unlock new weapon packs as you progress through a prototype playground of replayable FPS mechanics. From the creators of BATTALION.

games.title: 圣三国英杰传
games.description: The unique game of war chess, hundreds of military generals and equipment, experience the plot story of millions of copywriting, recruit generals all the way, obtain equipment, from a cloth clothes to the king of Hanzhong, until the defeat of Yiling.

games.title: East India Company
games.description: Trade exotic goods, command fleets, and dominate 17th-century seas. This blend of real-time strategy and naval warfare lets you build a trading empire across Europe and Asia. Strategize trade routes, engage in epic naval battles, and expand your influence to become the ultimate maritime force.

games.title: Multiplayer FPS Tutorial Demo
games.description: Ever wanted to create your own Multiplayer FPS? Now you can!"But.. it's hard." No, it isn't, you just need motivation and some basic programming knowledge.This game is the Free-to-play Demo of what you can create by watching the Video Series "How to Create a Multiplayer FPS in Unity" available on Steam Video Platform!

games.title: Bleeding Border
games.description: Bleeding Border is a first person 3d survival horror game in which the player must escape through the top of a monster infested building using his own blood as the only defense mechanism.

games.title: Commander: Conquest of the Americas
games.description: Set sail for the New World and shape the destiny of your empire. Lead one of seven European factions in this blend of colony management, exploration, and naval strategy. Build settlements, explore vast territories, and secure your legacy through diplomacy and tactical naval combat.

games.title: Gnumz: Masters of Defense
games.description: An enemy army is at our gates! Build an ideal chain of traps. Use magic and the power of the elements: earth, ice, fire and shadow.

games.title: Fantasy Kingdom Simulator
games.description: Fantasy Kingdom Simulator transports you into a medieval realm where you reign as King of four villages, and your duty is to help them grow and blossom into fully developed cities. You'll be making meaningful choices, important decisions and face the consequences if you plan poorly.

games.title: Eclipse
games.description: Once upon a time gods sent you here. You’ve slept in a glass sarcophagus for hundrends of years. When people find themselves on the brink of extinction, you’ll have to wake up. Now, the time has come. Get up and save the medieval village from the monsters coming from the abandoned dungeons!

games.title: Serpent in the Staglands
games.description: A true role-playing adventure. Set in the icy Staglands, this party-based CRPG has you take the role of a trapped god on a perilous journey across a beautiful, deadly peninsula.

games.title: Phobos
games.description: Discover an expansive online multiplayer world of battle, stories, and intrigue. Wield great weapons or conjure terrifying magics. Explore the world, solve quests, and slay great beasts and players alike.

games.title: Elves Adventure
games.description: Fate of the hero is in our hands, he is a stranger on new planet. He had occasion to return, but finally he stays and decides to help local people.

games.title: Massive Cleavage vs Zombies: Awesome Edition
games.description: Your mission is to find BBQ sauce for your people and bring it back to them. Fighting off thousands of zombies with only your massive cleaver and equally massive cleavage.

games.title: The Butterfly Sign
games.description: The Butterfly Sign is a detective story putting players into the role of the survivor of a disastrous incident. The protagonist takes an experimental drug which immerses him in the depths of his mind. In his memories, he will discover the ones responsible for the disaster, little by little, step by step…

games.title: Booster Trooper
games.description: Booster Trooper is the future of multiplayer platform shooters. It provides tons of fun with its fast paced action and larger-than-life weapons. You can run or fly around the map, blasting your enemies to bits with bullets, rockets, grenades, magma and other weapons from your arsenal.

games.title: Congo
games.description: Grab some friends and dive into the jungles of CONGO - an online and local co-op, horror action game. Set in the dark and haunting jungle, light-fearing demons attack from the shadows. Work together as a team to find rescue from wave after wave of intense attack by scavenging an array of weapons and items.

games.title: Echo of the Wilds
games.description: Echo of the Wilds is a puzzly narrativy adventure, featuring randomised wilderness survival. Explore and survive this mysterious tale of wilds. Gather resources to build gear and sustain yourself, learning new skills, lore and the intertwining interactions between the various areas, seasons, and weather.

games.title: Endless Horde
games.description: The horde is here to eat your brain and murder every single one of your scientists. Gather your forces, this is the last stand before we lose the facility! Place guards, close doors, and position traps. Survive as long as you can!

games.title: Japanese Women - Animated Jigsaws
games.description: "Animated Jigsaws" is a jigsaw puzzle game with videos instead of pictures. "Japanese Women - Animated Jigsaws" contains moving images of Japanese Women. In Japanese clothes called kimono, cool wearing yukata, Maiko in Kyoto, relaxed in a hot spring and etc. Please enjoy various women's jigsaw puzzles.

games.title: Redemption: Eternal Quest
games.description: Redemption: Eternal Quest is a casual RPG/Sim game which combines the feel of an RPG with roster management sim mechanics. You become the leader of a band of adventurers, guiding them through quests, watching them grow and signing them to pacts while keeping your gold pouch filled.

games.title: All Our Asias
games.description: In this free 3D adventure, explore someone's mind and discover their secrets in a surreal story about a father, son, Asian-America and more. Explore a dying father's "Memory World", and travel to familiar, supernatural spaces. By Melos, co-creator of Anodyne and Angeline Era.

games.title: Hooligan Vasja
games.description: Hooligan Vasja that is a colorful and entertaining time killer.Your goal is to reach the roof, fighting with different opponents. There is a powerful boss just under the roof. Be careful, the obstacles are extremely dangerous but you can knock them down. The first level is easy but the following ones are progressively more difficult.

games.title: Selfie: Sisters of the Amniotic Lens
games.description: The endless, halcyon days of the summer of love are over, the travellers and minstrels, dreamers and drug dealers have gone. Now it's 198X, you wake up in a very bad situation. You were the "Sisters of the amniotic lens" and now it's time to face what you did all those years ago.

games.title: The Crackpet Show: Prologue
games.description: The Crackpet Show is an action-packed rogue-lite shoot’em-up about mutated animals that fight in a bizarre TV show, crushing their opponents with a variety of weapons. Choose your beastie, gear ‘em up, and go kill your enemies in the name of fame and sweet sponsorship deals!

games.title: Legend of Dungeon: Masters
games.description: Interact with Legend of Dungeon Livestreams! Take pity on your friends as they toil in the dungeon, and send them glorious blades, potions, and bazookas.. or don’t! Help or hinder, it’s up to you!

games.title: Inner silence
games.description: Inner silence - cheerful 2D platformer puzzle game

games.title: Combat Monsters
games.description: Where CCG meets proper RPG combat.

games.title: Elysium: Blood Games
games.description: Enter a world of blood, influence and secrets in this easy to learn, yet deep strategy sim where you control a group of Gladiators, guiding them through combat and competition. Bribe, gamble and slash your way to an arena championship!

games.title: Crash Dive
games.description: WWII tactical submarine combat! Take command of a U-boat prowling the Atlantic in search of enemy convoys to sink. Sneak past the escorts and torpedo the transports. Or surface and use your deck gun in a daring night attack.

games.title: Star Wars: Imperial Assault - Legends of the Alliance
games.description: Legends of the Alliance is a companion app for the Star Wars: Imperial Assault board game, a scenario-based game of tactical combat. When you play with Legends of the Alliance, the app assumes the role of the Imperials, while you and your friends form a team of Rebel heroes fighting to bring down the Galactic Empire.

games.title: Earthworms
games.description: Detective story in a hand-painted, surrealist world of science-fiction. Full of riddles and puzzles, with a tone of pulp, horror and comedy. Inspired by movies and TV shows like: Donnie Darko, X Files, Stranger Things, Twin Peaks.

games.title: DreamWorks Dragons: Dawn of New Riders
games.description: Join the new heroic duo, Scribbler and Patch, in an epic battle to save dragons and defeat the villain, Eir, who is controlling dragons to carry out her evil plans.

games.title: Wanda
games.description: Wanda is a minimalist story-rich puzzle about two robotic lifeforms finding happiness, companionship and hope in a lonely post-apocalyptic world.

games.title: Nash Racing
games.description: Nash Racing is indie racing game, with lot of tracks, cars and tuning systems. Drive fast and be the best driver!

games.title: The Village
games.description: There are several game modes, Horror mode, Rescue mode, Intense mode and other modes that are yet to come. There are also several difficulties, where you may face a shortage of resources or resources found more easily. The game also features some online interactions.

games.title: Gloom
games.description: The game of inauspicious incidents and grave consequences. In this award winning card game, make your family as miserable as possible while making your rival's family as happy as you can! Push your family members down the stairs, make them be stabbed or eaten by bears before the grand finale: spoiler alert, everybody dies!

games.title: Agricultural Simulator 2011: Extended Edition
games.description: Assume the role of a farmer to make and manage your land. Invest in CLAAS machinery, crops, livestock, and other improvements.

games.title: Bounty Below
games.description: Bounty below is an idle adventure game about mining and smithing items. While your units are mining for you delve into the endless dungeon to gain even more ore!

games.title: Job the Leprechaun
games.description: Help Job the Leprechaun to rescue his friend Eri in this retro style Platformer Game.

games.title: Shadow Ninja: Apocalypse
games.description: Fast 2D ninja action where every mistake costs everything. Run, dodge, attack and survive as long as you can.

games.title: Masky
games.description: Dance to the mystic sounds and invite as many dancers as you can.

games.title: Three Dead Zed
games.description: Take control of an experimental zombie that can transform into three unique and distinct forms. With quick reflexes, a little problem solving, and some rescued kittens, players make a violent exit that won't be forgotten by their captors.

games.title: Chinatown Detective Agency: Day One
games.description: Become the detective in this free prologue for Chinatown Detective Agency. Amira Darma is new to the PI game, and you’ll need to use real-world detective skills to help her solve cases, manage her agency and unravel a global conspiracy in this globetrotting neo-noir mystery.

games.title: Lucky Night: Texas Hold'em VR
games.description: Have an enjoyable Texas hold’em game in virtual room with real players by HTC Vive or Oculus Rift.

games.title: Monster Puzzle
games.description: Far away, lost in another dimension, there‘s a world where human dreams come to life. A land built upon sweet dreams where Trekkie and her friends live, safe from the bitter monsters inhabiting the dark world of nightmares.

games.title: Ashina: The Red Witch: Prologue
games.description: The story is about Ash. An ordinary girl who takes a journey through a mysterious spirit world filled with strange creatures. Ash must find her way back home...before something else finds her.

games.title: Eisenwald: Blood of November
games.description: Eisenwald: Blood of November is a new sandbox adventure in the world of Eisenwald. Take up your arms and fight for your cause (and find out first who or what you want to be fighting for).

games.title: Extreme Racing on Highway
games.description: Race through highway traffic in this new endless racing game where you need to push the acceleration and test your car limits and receive money for your rewards and spend them on upgrades & new cars!

games.title: XIII Century
games.description: XIII Century Gold Edition combines the highly successful strategy game XIII Century: Death or Glory with the follow-up sequel, XIII Century: Blood of Europe.XIII Century: Death or Glory is an RTS game which immerses players in the Middle Ages.

games.title: Divination
games.description: "What if you're born into this world without your permission?" DIVINATION is a very short visual novel where you act as a fortune teller in a futuristic world. Talk and listen to people's stories, then foresee their future using the runes they had drawn.

games.title: The Secret of Retropolis
games.description: The Secret of Retropolis is a VR narrative game of a new kind, a blend of classic point-and-click adventure with immersive cinematography. Embody the witty protagonist of a film noir plot. Meet unforgettable characters. Solve puzzles. Lose yourself in the retro-futuristic atmosphere.

games.title: Escape: VR
games.description: The main objective in this game is to find your way out.

games.title: City Zoomer
games.description: A movement focused endless anime runner. Jump till you're dead.

games.title: Sentience: The Android's Tale
games.description: You can remember nothing before this moment. Your existence begins with a keystroke followed by the flick of a switch. Electrical power streams into your neural network, and you are alive.

games.title: Downtown Mafia: Gang Wars
games.description: Addictive text-based Mafia MMO RPG where you team up with other players to wage Gang Wars, Turf Wars, Boss Fights, Hire Mercs, Hit-List your enemies, buy weapons, vehicles and equipments, City-based Missions, TOURNAMENTS and much more..

games.title: Seek Or Die
games.description: You are an investigator hired to find evidence about the missing children in the manor off the road. Once you enter, the door locks behind you, and you can hear something, lurking...

games.title: Tenrow
games.description: Tenrow is a logic puzzle game. Includes 50 levels.

games.title: Blob From Space
games.description: Blob From Space is a 2d side scroller game. Difficulty will change when progressing. Try to survive many challenges with only 3 continues! Let the rage begin!

games.title: Magnifico
games.description: Magnifico is the only strategy game with Da Vinci’s inventions and works of art. It comes from a popular region-based board game where the ultimate goal is to dominate 16th century Europe.

games.title: Incandescent
games.description: Incandescent is a fast paced action arcade game that scales the difficulty to your skill level. The goal is simple, pilot your ship and defend yourself against waves of unique enemies and bosses. Different powerups will drop to help you with upgrades to your weapons and health.

games.title: Sharded World
games.description: Sharded World is a reversed bullet hell, rogue-lite, ARPG game combining simple gameplay and great rpg progression. Each level has its own unique features and challenges. Upgradable characters, weapons and orbs. Challenges, daily quests, and leaderboards. Fight, get stronger and defeat the Lich!

games.title: That's Mahjong!
games.description: That's Mahjong! is a Solitaire Mahjong tile matching game, where the purpose is to match tiles of the same type, or any two season tiles. How much karma can you gather?

games.title: Die by the Blade
games.description: Vanquish your foes with a single strike in 1v1 weapon-based fighter Die by the Blade. Dive into a samuraipunk world and wield a range of traditional Japanese weapons to determine your moveset. Outwit your opponent in intense, tactical battles and master the art of the one-hit kill!

games.title: Grace of Zordan
games.description: Tactical-strategic turn-based card game, the key focus is on the player's ability to assess the situation and control the battlefield.

games.title: Little Kite
games.description: The game about one tragic evening for a struggling family, when emotions and tensions are simply too high to manage.

games.title: Avalon Lords: Dawn Rises
games.description: "Dive into 'Avalon Lords: Dawn Rises', an RTS set in a mystical medieval world. Build your kingdom, lead vast armies, and uncover Avalon's legends. Chapter 1 launches in October, featuring the Dawn faction. Join our Discord for sneak peeks!

games.title: Khet 2.0
games.description: Officially licensed version of the “Mensa Select” award-winning board game! The Laser Game Khet 2.0: Mind blowing laser fun for players ages 9-99. Using simple rules that can be learned in minutes players alternate turns moving Egyptian themed mirrored pieces, after which they fire their laser with the goal of blasting their opponents...

games.title: Tempo
games.description: A rhythm platforming game but instead of staying on the beat… you play at your own beat!

games.title: Incitement 3
games.description: An expansive dystopian sci-fi world awaits you! Equipment customization, a varied cast and an epic story in this sci-fi epic from Astronomic Games.

games.title: For The Glory
games.description: Take up the reins of your country, guide domestic and foreign policy, navigate thousands of historical figures and events, engage in various struggles and lead your country to prosperity – all in the name of glory!

games.title: Science Girls
games.description: Schoolgirls fight aliens with the power of science! Gather a team of science-themed specialists and defend your homeworld in classic turn-based combat.

games.title: Pixel Shopkeeper
games.description: Be a Pixel Shopkeeper! Collect items using inventory management puzzle mechanics. Sell your wares, decorate your shop, craft new products, and expand! Train to beat tougher dungeons, unlock new classes and decor, and furnish your shop smartly to maximize profits!

games.title: Mini Golf Mundo
games.description: Mini Golf Mundo is a fun casual game suitable to players of all ages and experience levels. Your task is to Putt the ball to victory across 4 challenging courses with a total of 72 holes to complete. You can choose to play alone or invite friends and family to partake in a 4-player turn-based tournament.

games.title: Fake Colours
games.description: The best new puzzle game around is ready to challenge you! Are you ready to take on the 30 levels of Fake Colours?

games.title: Psycho Starship Rampage
games.description: You play the psychotic A.I. of a warship lost in space which tries to come back to Earth. Build your spaceship from scratch. Load it with weapons. And use your creation to destroy waves of innocent aliens throughout numerous levels. Loot their carcasses, extend your ship and jump to the next sector for more action!

games.title: Star Control I & II
games.description: Explore a vast universe with pulse-pounding action, side-splitting humor, and hair-raising plot twists in these 2 classic space adventure games.

games.title: Twisted Worlds
games.description: Play an exciting fantasy hidden object game for sci-fi lovers and save the world from peril. A brave adventurer, you discover a magical portal and get drawn into a mystery greater than you ever expected. Solve thrilling puzzles and investigate hidden object scenes as you journey into the unknown.

games.title: ASSASSINATION BOX
games.description: ASSASSINATION BOX is a first person shooter. Fight endless waves of enemies in Survival mode or start stealth night mission. Fight for a better score and higher rank.

games.title: Days Under Custody
games.description: Days Under Custody is a title made as a classic horror adventure game where a dramatic story, unique puzzles and an enemy stalking you all the time, will test and keep you tense to discover the history behind a lot of inexplicable events.

games.title: There Was a Caveman
games.description: There Was A Caveman is a prehistoric themed, retro styled, action platformer. With challenging gameplay that will keep you on your toes. Get ready to die and die a lot.

games.title: Plastic Playground
games.description: Plastic PlayGround is a fast paced, team based, LAN multiplayer first-person shooter. In PPG you play as everyones favorite toy only this time you get to run, jump, jetpack, grapple, and fly. The goal is to capture as many control points as you can while eliminating and evading hostile toys from the enemy team.

games.title: Twilight Town
games.description: Delve up the darkest secrets of mystical city and unravel the web of intrigues in a compelling hidden object game Twilight Town!

games.title: Kyn
games.description: In a world where Viking mythology collides with magic, explore the world of KYN in a fast paced role playing strategy game that combines party based combat with exploration and progression.

games.title: Sweet Lily Dreams
games.description: The peaceful Realm of Dreams is about to be consumed by a terrible and maleficent nightmare. You must venture into the darkness and battle fearsome literary foes such as Hyde, the Headless Horseman and Dracula. Join Lily on a sugar-coated adventure about inner strength with a dark interior.

games.title: The Dragoness: Command of the Flame
games.description: The Dragoness mixes HOMM-like exploration, city-building and turn-based strategic combat, with a roguelite twist. Choose your battles, paths and skills as you explore a world ravaged by war. Gather and manage your army of beasts, collect resources and expand your city.

games.title: Ancient Guardian
games.description: Ancient Guardian - action adventure in procedurally-generated locations. You play as father, who have to find his lost daughter, avoiding meeting dangerous enemies, bypassing traps and solving puzzles.

games.title: DESTRUCTURE: Among Debris
games.description: DESTRUCTURE: Among Debris is an intense mix of brick breaker, air hockey and bullet hell set in a post apocalyptic world. Destroy structures, dodge bullets, fire guns and buy perks to lay even more waste!

games.title: Find Out
games.description: Find Out - this is an adventure game in which you will have to escape from an unknown location, surrounded by a large maze.

games.title: HyperBrawl Tournament
games.description: HyperBrawl Tournament is the ultimate arena combat sport. Assemble your team of intergalactic heroes, arm them with outrageous weapons and score your way to victory in classic single player campaigns, couch or online play for up to four players.

games.title: The chronicles of Emerland. Solitaire.
games.description: Defeat the dark forces - win a battle for Emerland!

games.title: SQUAKE
games.description: The mix of Snake+Quake! Quite clever, eh? We thought so. SQUAKE is a massive multiplayer action-packed combat-trains game! Collect wagons to become longer. Destroy other trains and try to not die by hitting yourself, because that would be totally embarrassing.

games.title: Bannerman
games.description: Bannerman is a gritty and atmospheric medieval action/adventure with a bleak narrative and focus on historically accurate, challenging skill-based swordfighting!

games.title: Airport Simulator 2019
games.description: Airport Simulator 2019 places you as the manager of a major international airport. Your duties range from planning and allocating personnel to procuring and maintaining a vehicle fleet, facility maintenance and handling ever larger aircraft from a variety of airlines.

games.title: The Riese Project - Prologue
games.description: Some stories are better left in the dark. But some will find you. In Riese, echoes don’t always answer the same. A narrative FPP/VR experience about a past that refuses to stay silent.

games.title: Distant Space 2
games.description: Distant Space 2 - is an indirect continuation of the first part, in which you will find more dynamic gameplay. Your task is to destroy enemy ships on each level to go to the next of 26 available. In addition to conventional ships, you will have to wait for the boss ships, the battle with which will not be easy.

games.title: Blake Stone: Aliens of Gold
games.description: Wolfenstein 3D took you into the past, thrusting you into a world at war. Blake rockets you into the future where a sinister madman, using genetics to create an army of bizarre creatures, is waging war on Earth. Blake has more of everything!

games.title: Chess Knight 2
games.description: A medieval world of strategy and tactics await you to engage in epic battles of wits as you master the moves and the strategies in a conquest to claim the kingdom of Chess.

games.title: Judas
games.description: Judas is an atmospheric psychological horror experience. Accidentally trapped in an apartment complex, you face dark paranormal events that push you to escape as fast as possible; yet, fleeing is not an option.

games.title: Tortuga - A Pirate's Tale
games.description: Tortuga - A Pirate’s Tale tells the journey of a pirate captain with a lust for gold and glory who assumes command of a fleet of pirate ships to strike the Caribbean.

games.title: Garden Rescue
games.description: Help the plants to defend the garden from being invaded by sneaky beetles.

games.title: Genesis
games.description: Genesis is a controller exclusive next generation online-competitive MOBA. Utilizing Unreal 4 Engine, it boasts stunning graphics and smooth control. Genesis differentiates from classic MOBA games by opting for joystick control which is highly optimized （Mouse and keyboard control is not supported）.

games.title: King Lucas
games.description: Metroidvania game with 2.5D graphics, single and multiplayer modes and classic game mechanics for the delight of platform and adventure games lovers as well as for you who didn't live the 80's; this is an opportunity for you to taste that classic feeling with the graphics and sound quality of today.

games.title: Rocket Science
games.description: Take part in a space program. Design spacecrafts and send them off to explore the vast expanses of space. Experience the real scale of the Solar system and the size of its celestial bodies.

games.title: Gravity Field
games.description: Gravity Field is a spatial-logic puzzle game with time inverted objects, with no top or bottom.

games.title: Bunker 58
games.description: Locked inside of Bunker 58 with major threats surrounding you, you question yourself how much you value your life, and how much you will kill to keep it.

games.title: Cosmo's Cosmic Adventure
games.description: What's green with red spots, has suction hands, and has an overbite like Bart Simpson? Of course, the answer is Cosmo! Cosmo is a young alien on his way to visit Disney World with his parents. That is, until their ship is struck by a blazing comet, forcing them to land on an uncharted planet.

games.title: Byte Family
games.description: Overcome obstacles and restore the cyber world ByteFamily, eliminating the system virus, unlocking new game modes and gaining new skills! HERE IS THE TERRIBLE WORLD ENEMIES BYTE FAMILY

games.title: HordeCore
games.description: HordeCore is a kick-ass side-scrolling shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world. Play alone, or as a team - and destroy, survive, craft, and explore!

games.title: Multimirror
games.description: Multimirror is a minimal grid-based puzzle game.

games.title: The Slaughter: Act One
games.description: The Slaughter is a noir point-and-click adventure set in Victorian London, laced with adult themes and dark humour. Follow the trail of a killer through atmospheric London locations and surreal dream worlds, meeting a cast of interesting, insane and eccentrically British characters along the way.

games.title: "Glow Ball" - The billiard puzzle game
games.description: Physics based puzzle game type of billiards. If you like billiard games or love pool then this game is for you!

games.title: Madrobot X
games.description: MadRobot X is an old school shoot 'em up game. You control a robot trying to escape from the laboratory of a mad scientist, and to accomplish this, you'll need the help of GoboGobo, another robot who also wants to escape.

games.title: Suicide Guy VR
games.description: Experience Suicide Guy now in Virtual Reality for the greatest, most immersive snooze! These surreal dreams have never been so chaotic and frantic. If you're faint of heart, do not play this game.

games.title: Die Again
games.description: Die Again is an innovative shooter where you kill enemies shooting and dying. If, when dying, there is an enemy nearby, you can possess their body and keep playing. But be careful, the enemies can do the same to you. Shoot to kill, die to survive, kill yourself to overcome!

games.title: The Librarian
games.description: Liz's library is threatened by the unknown. She must go investigate. She's the librarian, after all.

games.title: Inside The Gear
