games.description: Blonde Driver is parking simulator. You need to park your car with minimal hits.

games.title: Don't open the doors!
games.description: Claymation action adventure in an odd world of talking pumpkins, blue trees and stuff like that.

games.title: Epic Snails
games.description: Create a snail and join the battle. Take control of the backyard with Battle Snails! Climb walls, hang upside down and move anywhere. Team up with your friends for a tank game unlike any other!

games.title: The Spatials
games.description: It's the year 5781 -- and you have been chosen to build and lead a space station in a wild corner of the galaxy! Attract visitors and explore hundreds of planets to fund your station.

games.title: Ticket to Ride: First Journey
games.description: Ticket to Ride: First Journey takes the gameplay of the Ticket to Ride series and scales it downs for a younger audience. Very simple and family-friendly, Ticket to Ride: First Journey includes both North America and Europe maps.

games.title: Idle Heist
games.description: Idle Heist is an Idle/Clicker game where the objective is to get as much money from the bank vault before you get caught! Through the use of upgrades and skills, earn MILLIONS or even TRILLIONS of dollars. This is the perfect game to play whilst you work or do other tasks!

games.description: Try the challenging Arena mode, a free standalone version of an upcoming hand-drawn beat’em up adventure Tunche, a glorious return of classic 2D beat'em up gameplay mixed with roguelike elements, hand-drawn 2D style and witchcraft.

games.title: Tick Tock Isle
games.description: Strike is inadvertently transported into the past while attempting to repair a mysterious, abandoned clock tower.  Endeavoring to return to the future, Strike must fix both the time machine and the island’s dysfunctional family who are responsible for much of the clock’s disrepair.

games.title: Astral Heroes
games.description: Astral Heroes is a Collectible Card Game that's simple to learn, exciting to play, and deep enough to challenge even the greatest strategists. It's the spiritual sequel to our older game, Astral Masters, which still enjoys a loyal following over ten years after its release!

games.title: Aurora Nights
games.description: Aurora Nights is an entertaining educational game for learning to identify the constellations.

games.title: Legendary Hoplite: Ajax’s Trial
games.description: Legendary Hoplite: Ajax's Trial is the prologue version of Legendary Hoplite, a game that combines Tower Defense and Action RPG genres. In this game, you'll need to build fortifications, upgrade your army, and create your own unique strategy to fight off hordes of monsters across 7 levels.

games.title: 牧剑:化神书(Tale Of Swords: Mystery Scroll)
games.description: 《牧剑：化神书》是一款3D即时战斗的仙侠风格角色扮演游戏。故事从主角李朔在三清山悠闲的日子开始，突然闯来求助的金丹门弟子，宣告了主角幸福日子的完结。然而走出师门，李朔才发现，这世界上，还有另一张巨大的网似乎已经逐渐张开。玩家也将跟随李朔一起，一步步踏足这个充满未知的世界。

games.title: The Pegasus Expedition
games.description: The Pegasus Expedition is a story-driven sci-fi grand strategy game set in a key moment for humankind’s survival. Facing an overwhelming threat at home, humanity sends expeditions to the Pegasus Galaxy in a desperate attempt to find a refuge for the population of Earth.

games.title: Demonsomnia
games.description: Demonsomnia is a CO-OP multiplayer bodycam horror game focused on the impact of nuclear reactions. Radiation has spread everywhere, so put on your gas mask. Your goal is to activate the nuclear reactor device and escape without being caught by mutants.

games.title: NEO AQUARIUM - The King of Crustaceans -

games.title: Mimpi
games.description: Explore strange new worlds and enjoy unique adventures in Mimpi! Mimpi is fantastic new adventure, puzzle, and platformer game.  The game is like a psychedelic illustration come alive.  Mimpi the dog is searching for his master in eight diverse worlds. The environment is seldom repetitive, the puzzles are always new.

games.title: Moebius: Empire Rising
games.description: Moebius: Empire Rising is a contemporary adventure that merges classic point-and-click puzzle solving with Jane Jensen’s sophisticated storytelling. Travel the world using Malachi’s unique deductive powers to analyze suspects, make historical connections, and uncover the truth behind a theory of space and time the government will defend...

games.title: Overclocked
games.description: Overclocked is a free-flowing action game that blends combat and platforming to create a fluid and rhythmic experience. Take on the role of Amber, a glass-cannon vigilante, as you fight to uncover a plot that threatens to tear your home apart.

games.title: Raiden Legacy

games.title: Magical Valkyrie Lyristia
games.description: The evil organization Fakker has been terrorizing the residents of the city at night, abducting people left and right. One woman stands against them: Magical Valkyrie Frostia. One day, she saves another woman with the potential to transform and their fate may be changed forever...

games.title: Nancy Drew: Secrets Can Kill
games.description: Play the Game that Started the Award-Winning Series!

games.title: AZURA
games.description: AZURA - exciting adventure story in the genre of RPG. Explore an unknown island. Classic combat turn-based system in the best traditions of JRPG, non-linear plot with the choice of the path and juicy anime graphics.

games.title: Extremely Realistic Siege Warfare Simulator
games.description: Extremely Realistic Siege Warfare Simulator is a physics-based tactical strategy game where you must lead a military force in a fantasy medieval world. Build an army. Construct siege equipment. Experience epic battles. Lead your people to victory!!

games.title: Gnomes Garden
games.description: Dry summer withered the king’s beloved garden and the surrounding gardens of the kingdom alike. The ruler has fallen ill and the kingdom is in danger. Help the princess save the gardens and make the king better again.

games.title: Chicken Farm 2K17
games.description: Chicken Farm is a management game with clicker aspects, where you buy chickens, catch the eggs, work at the market, sell your chickens and ultimately profit.

games.title: Kitchen Simulator 2015
games.description: Kitchen simulator, The game that turns you into the chef. As the owner and chef of your very own restaurant, you now have the responsibilities to keep your place clean, serving quality meals to your hungry customers, Impressing the high class to get to that fancy five star restaurant,more…

games.title: Beware Planet Earth
games.description: Beware Planet Earth! is a beguiling mix of classic tower defense and time management coming to PC via Steam for the first time. Save your cows from the Martian invasion by building an effective defense using towers, traps and objects, and also by firing your Zapper directly at the invading force of little green men!

games.title: Rabbit Hole 3D: Steam Edition
games.description: Rabbit Hole 3D: Steam Edition is a minimalistic retro puzzle game. The game features 3D word puzzles based on Chapter 1 of Alice in Wonderland by Lewis Carroll. Players must navigate through keywords from the book’s initial chapter.

games.title: Japanese School Life
games.description: Welcomed by the fluttering of cherry blossom, the main character, Brian, starts a new high school life in Japan. Brian soon starts to get along with two girls in the same class after they start to talk to him. With their help, Brian gradually learns Japanese culture and customs.

games.title: Marble Skies
games.description: Marble Skies is a fast paced 3D-platformer where you control your marble through various levels and try to get the best time for each one. Complete all the levels in your own time, or challenge your friends to get on top of the leaderboards!

games.title: Power Hover
games.description: Take control of the hoverboarding robots, explore the desolate world, defy gravity, dive into the oceans and ride with the sandworms on the dunes! Stylish graphics and groovy soundtrack will take you to an epic adventure in this action/racing game.

games.description: Puzzle Kingdoms challenges players to plan out strategic attacks in order to defeat their opponents. Order troops across the map, conquering cities through innovative puzzle gameplay. Players build and manage armies led by heroic commanders to save the world of Etheria from the brink of destruction.

games.description: You got a problem? Yo, she’ll splode it. At the Big Science after-party celebrating the capture of Splosion Man, a spill of champagne shorts out the safety protocols on the splosionatrix and from it emerges Ms. Splosion Man. The latest creation from Twisted Pixel Games, the creators of Splosion Man, The Maw, and Comic Jumper, Ms.

The VR Museum of Fine Art
Brink of Consciousness: Dorian Gray Syndrome
Grabity

games.description: Best played with the lights turned off and the volume turned up, Black Sails is a creepy and mysterious point-and-click adventure game.Two survivors of a shipwreck try to survive in the raging sea. Until another ship appears. Hoping for rescue, they are calling, but nobody answers. They manage to go on board. Will this be their rescue?

games.title: Distant Star: Revenant Fleet
games.description: BAFTA award winning fleet-based RTS meets rogue-lite. In Distant Star: Revenant Fleet, build your fleet of up to 5 ships from a choice of 8 classes and traverse a randomly generated galaxy to defeat the Erebus Platform. NOW AVAILABLE ON MAC AND LINUX

games.title: Forsaken World: Gods and Demons
games.description: The most popular Fantasy RPG of 2021 is finally available!

games.title: Impulsion
games.description: Impulsion is a fast-paced first-person platformer designed to play with your nerves and reflexes! Make your way through 25 levels of increasing difficulty by manipulating physics to your advantage, shooting force fields to slow down or speed yourself up and the environment!

games.title: Leisure Suit Larry 1 - In the Land of the Lounge Lizards
games.description: “What’s your sign, baby?” - Larry Laffer “Wrong Way.” -any woman.

games.title: SHOWTIME 2073
games.description: The best shooter SHOW in 2073.Explosive, Fun & full destructive !

games.title: Warmonger

games.title: Dark Swords
games.description: DarkSwords combines the traditional role-playing system with innovative approach to the game process implementation, character development and social aspect. You can join the players from all parts of the world right now for free!

games.title: DubWars
games.description: DubWars is a music game that combines the mechanics of a top-down shooter with the power of Dubstep and Electronic music. Your weapons are synced to the music creating times of intense weapon load outs and calm moments where your survival skills are tested.

games.title: Saku Saku: Love Blooms with the Cherry Blossoms
games.description: A girl who cannot fall in love. A boy who has no interest in love. If they were to fall in love with each other, how would the world change? From Palette, developers of "Mashiro Iro Symphony", comes the romantic school comedy, "Saku Saku: Love Blooms with the Cherry Blossoms."

games.title: 子夜之章:历史的终局~MidNights of Desperado~
games.description: The protagonist of this lonely life is you. You leave your hometown and come to a strange world. The world is prosperous and cold, strange but real. You may like it or wish you could tear it to pieces. The good news is, you have the choice!

games.title: Escape
games.description: Escape is a simple 2D game with 35 levels already unlocked (for the sake of gaming of course). Require jumping skills, a brain and patience. Enjoy :)

games.title: Rot Gut
games.description: Rot Gut is an action packed platformer set in America’s 1920’s Prohibition era. You take control of an agent who, to uncover their mysteries, goes on a mission to fight the city’s underground armed to the teeth organizations.

games.title: Robowars
games.description: Robowars is back on Steam! Fight off troops of droids for freedom and honor in our classical tower defense game. Lead the forces of the Solar Union to protect the peaceful planet of Praymos from the aggressive Trade Confederation.

games.title: BROK the InvestiGator - Prologue
games.description: The very first PUNCH & CLICK! Brok is an innovative adventure mixed with beat 'em up and RPG elements. In a grim world where animals have replaced mankind, what kind of detective will you be?

games.title: Gravity Wars
games.description: Gravity Wars is an hardcore 90s Arcade local multiplayer game where you have to avoid waves of geometry entities.

games.title: Insanity's Blade
games.description: Take a father’s journey to hell in order to save the souls of his wife and child. Insanity's Blade: The Chronicles of Thurstan is the first in a series of games based around the journey of a sword possessed by a father's powerful grief and hatred. This is the tale of the sword's creation.

games.title: Nancy Drew®: Mystery of the Seven Keys
games.description: A thrilling blend of adventure, mystery, and history! Play as Nancy Drew to uncover the truth behind the theft of a client's heirloom necklace. Solve challenging puzzles, uncover a sinister web of cyber crime, and sleuth through Prague's mysterious streets entwined with medieval legends and alchemy.

games.title: Solar System VR
games.description: An educational virtual reality journey through space. Be the first space tourist in history and explore planets and moons in our Solar System like never before. You can experience a journey to the Earth's moon, explore Mars, and even see the surface of Enceladus, one of Saturn's moons.

games.title: The Night Way Home 帰り道
games.description: The Night Way Home is a Japanese survival horror game.

games.title: Kill to Collect
games.description: Welcome to the last city on Earth. Earn your keep and die trying in Pieces Interactive’s cyberpunk action rogue-like, featuring 1-4 player co-op. Travel down the sleepless cesspool of murderous vagrants and cybernetic freaks, as you slice and dice your way to the lower levels of Geoshelter Alpha.

games.title: Pixel Survivors
games.description: Pixel Survivors is a god management game. Create some land and build structures to keep your small society settled. See how long you can keep your village alive!

games.title: Plain Sight
games.description: Plain Sight is a multiplayer arcade game about suicidal ninja robots. Fly through space, leap over planetoids and destroy opponents with your trusty katana. Killing fellow robots lets you steal their tasty, tasty energy. Packed with spinach-like goodness; energy makes you bigger, stronger, faster and generally more awesome.

games.title: It Comes In Waves
games.description: A short, minimalist, experimental open-world adventure about guilt and grief. Explore, shoot, scavenge and bring a specimen to The Sanctuary. Beware PERMADEATH.

games.title: Desperados 2: Cooper’s Revenge
games.description: Desperados 2 is the sequel to the successful wild west title Desperados - Wanted Dead or Alive. The gameplay is based on its predecessor but with brand new tactical possibilities in a beautiful 3D environment. Switch from an isometric view to a third person view whenever you want; for example, for duels, brawls and shoot-outs.

games.title: Hotel Giant 2
games.description: Following its international success, Hotel Giant is back and bigger than ever. In Hotel Giant 2 you will create the hotel of your dreams and manage prestigious locations around the world. Your goal is to attract as many guests as possible and make sure they are satisfied throughout their stay.

games.title: Last Inua
games.description: Last Inua is an immersive and emotional platform adventure game developed by Glowforth. A captivating experience, Last Inua tells the tale of an Inuit family’s fight for survival in the harsh elements of the mythical Arctic. The Tonrar, a demonic trickster, has awoken in the arctic.

games.title: Zombeer
games.description: In the near (and some might say, lucky) future, there is a pandemic transforming the world’s population into zombies. That’s not the lucky part – it’s this: Once bitten by a zombie, the only way to stave off the infection is drinking beer!

games.title: DeathSpank: Thongs Of Virtue
games.description: Join DeathSpank in the hunt for the Thongs of Virtue! Fight through all new environments and quests and collect all new weapons, armor, and loot in one of the funniest action-RPGs to date!

games.title: Escape First 2
games.description: "Escape First 2" is the second installment of a multiplayer escape room puzzle game for virtual reality or desktop PC! It includes 3 different escape rooms to choose from and can be played competitively, co-op or solo.

games.title: 東方花映塚 ~ Phantasmagoria of Flower View.
games.description: 桜、紫陽花、向日葵、彼岸花、 幻想の花は散ることなく咲き続ける。弾幕の花も然り。 弾幕の対戦型フラワリングシューティング！一人でも大変遊べます。

games.title: Demon Hunter 2: New Chapter

games.title: Madballs in...Babo: Invasion

games.title: Alice's Patchwork

It will be the first in a multi-genre series of games centered around the story of Terrius, KR-17's home.

Through the bloody battleground in Gado island, defeat all other mercenaries and find “The Dragon’s Jade” to reveal the legend of Nine Dragon’s Legacy.

games.title: Rituals
games.description: Rituals is a 3D puzzle-exploration-adventure about the relation between civilisation and nature. It aims to be a gripping, memorable and meaningful experience with story told through gameplay and interaction.

games.title: Woodle Tree 2: Worlds
games.description: Woodle Tree 2: Worlds is an open world platformer/adventure videogame. This time the forces of evil are taking over the Wood Lands with a black substance that is absorbing energy and life from the living creatures! Will you be able to take over this enormous new evil force?

games.title: World Ship Simulator
games.description: Set in a fictitious environment inspired by ports from around the world. Captain a hovercraft, bulk carrier, yacht and other magnificent vessels in an expansive open world career

games.title: Escape Quest
games.description: Embark on an escape game adventure alone or with up to 3 friends. Set in a medieval fantasy world, communication & observation will be your key tools to succeed and free yourself.

games.title: Fragsurf
games.description: Fragsurf is a dynamic blend of multiplayer first-person shooter PvP, strafing, surfing, and bunnyhop, allowing players to engage in high-speed maneuvers and combat.

games.title: PAC-MAN MUSEUM
games.description: PAC-MAN stars in a nostalgia-packed collection of the greatest PAC-MAN games of all time. PAC-MAN MUSEUM will include classic PAC-MAN titles as well as newer releases, allowing gamers to play through the evolution of PAC-MAN from his humble beginnings from 1980 through current hits like PAC-MAN Championship Edition and PAC-MAN Battle...

games.title: eXceed 2nd - Vampire REX
games.description: The human powers-that-be called for the purification of mankind and the eradication of vampires and ‘deviants bloodlines’ - those born of a mix of human and vampire. And so began massive purges of the deviants that were reminiscent of the 'witch hunts' of centuries earlier.

games.title: Grimmwood Open beta
games.description: Explore – Craft – Survive: Grimmwood is a challenging social multiplayer RPG seamlessly blending survival, roguelike and exploration. Defend your village together with up to 30 strangers in a mystical forest against the merciless monsters who unleash their wrath against your shelter every night!

games.title: Huntsman - The Orphanage Halloween Edition
games.description: MORE STORY THAN GORY! A HYBRID OF ALTERNATIVE HORROR AND CREEPYPASTA...Welcome to the Halloween Edition v1.03! Take a deep breath, dim the lights, put on your headphones...Non-linear first-person gameplay lets you explore Grimhaven Orphanage and discover the characters who once lived there – voiced by Dan Bull, Chuck Huber and Raychul...

games.title: Just Click The Button
games.description: In "Just Click The Button," you do indeed, click on a button. The more you click, the more the game evolves. Select new abilities that align with your playstyle. Decide whether to attempt to beat the game after reaching a certain threshold or play indefinitely!

games.title: Labyrinth
games.description: UPDATED! Embark on a new adventure: Assemble powerful decks of Heroes to invade rival dungeons and engage in epic PvP 3D battles--then, use the loot from your conquests to customize your own dungeon and put together a powerful deck of bosses and minions to defend your riches at all costs.

games.title: Ostrich Island
games.description: Don't be an ostrich, play Ostrich! Gain experience points and unlock new skills and achievements! Feel creative? Create whole new islands and share it with community!

games.title: Explorer of Yggdrasil
games.description: After rescuing an armless mage during a chance encounter, the explorer Mei embarks on a journey to reach the top of Yggdrasil, and to uncover the mystery of her forgotten past.

games.title: Epic Car Factory
games.description: Epic Car Factory puts you in the drivers seat of your very own car company. Build, market, hire, fire, and more in this fast paced business simulation. The failure and success of the company depends entirely on your decisions and how you react to the ever changing market place.

games.title: Ninja Hanrei
games.description: Ninja Hanrei is a 2D run and gun Platformer game inspired on Ancient Japan but with Super Powers.

games.title: World of Tennis: Roaring ’20s
games.description: World of Tennis: Roaring ’20s is a realistic tennis game featuring global multiplayer and tactical gameplay across a variety of incredible, life-like locations – all set in the roaring ’20s!

games.title: Theatre of War 2: Africa 1943
games.description: Theatre of War 2: Africa 1943 covers the events of 1943 in Tunisia, North Africa. Recovering from their losses after the crushing defeat and subsequent retreat after the Second Battle of El-Alamein, the German Afrika Korps - reinforced and now supported by the Italian Army - prepare once more to put steel against steel with the Allies.

games.title: Arrogation: Unlight of Day
games.description: Arrogation: Unlight of Day is a psychological horror game set in World War II. You will play as a lone reporter searching for his lost family in an abandoned village from 80s China. Beyond darkness, you will find nightmarish creatures and secrets from the long lost Imperial Japanese Army.

games.title: Bomb The Monsters!
games.description: Don't make these monsters angry! Fire your bombs at those lousy creatures and get buildings to collapse on them. With lovely HD graphics and awesome physics!

games.title: Bridge Constructor Playground
games.description: Bridge Constructor Playground offers people of all ages an introduction to the topic of “bridge building”. This game gives you the freedom to let your creative side run riot – nothing is impossible. Across 30 innovative levels you have to build bridges over deep valleys, canals or rivers.

games.title: Deadlings - Rotten Edition
games.description: Arcade side-scroller with strategy elements! Four different types of zombie minions with unique abilities! 70 levels of pure zombie gore fun! Additional game mode - Nightmare - only for the hardcore gamers!

games.title: Dracula 3: The Path of the Dragon
games.description: There is obviously no such thing as vampires... at least according to the official line of the Catholic Church. The trilogy continues as the Prince of Darkness rises again.

games.title: Margonem
games.description: Addictive pixel-art MMORPG! Start playing today!

games.title: New York Mysteries: High Voltage
games.description: Fearless journalist Laura is again brought in to investigate strange murders taking place in New York. Immerse yourself in an exciting crime story and solve the mystery of a dangerous criminal surrounded by lightning!

games.title: Purgatory
games.description: Most stories end with the death of the protagonist. For Xzus, death is where things started to get really interesting...

games.title: Dark Eden
games.description: ‘Dark Eden’, the real R.P.G game, will provide you a new experience you did not have from the other games before. Welcome to the world of ‘Dark Eden’ themed in Vampire which isdifferentiated from the typical fantasy world.

games.title: Mystic Saga
games.description: Reveal the secrets of the past, find ancient scrolls, and find out about the prophecy ancestors! Decipher ancient spells and find magic keys to mastering the power of all the elements!

games.title: Theatre Of The Absurd
games.description: An Ancient and most sinister evil threatens the soul of an innocent young girl. Explore the remote and mysterious theatre to uncover lost horrors and find the solution. Can you outwit the beast?

games.title: Captain Starshot
games.description: Fight fierce hostile alien space ships to neutralize their defenses before you board their ships and battle intense on-foot encounters. Eliminate their forces and steal their technology to upgrade your squad with different abilities and save the galaxy!

games.title: Realities
games.description: Explore what was out of reach before - travel to mesmerizing real world places and discover their stories!

games.title: The Body VR: Journey Inside a Cell
games.description: The Body VR: Journey Inside a Cell is an educational virtual reality experience that takes the user inside the human body.

games.title: Born Into Fear
games.description: Born Into Fear is a first-person horror game set in an evacuated neighborhood. You'll have to complete task and avoid enemies to destroy the evil Buffer.

games.title: Emergency 2016
games.description: There's no shortage of action in EMERGENCY 2016. Command firefighters, police, technical relief forces and paramedics in all new emergencies. With a brand new vehicle and large scale events, you'll take on rescue missions like never before!

games.title: Palace of Cards
games.description: Play cards online with other players from around the world and choose from 6 unique games: Rummy, Solitaire, Mau-Mau (Crazy Eights), Skat, Sheepshead & Doppelkopf. games.title: SACRALITH : The Archer`s Tale

games.title: Snowdome
games.description: For Tan Yan, there is little hope his life will change. It's like his whole life is trapped inside a snowdome, unable to escape. But, what if, one day, he's given the chance to make a change?

games.title: Universal Combat CE
games.description: The ultimate space capital ship combat compendium is the evolution of hard core space combat sims. The only game of its kind currently in existence.

games.title: Winter Voices
games.description: A unique adventure, a stunning scenario to discover in one season!

games.title: Dream Cycle

games.title: OUTBUDDIES DX

games.title: Starr Mazer: DSP

games.title: Xuan-Yuan Sword 2

games.title: Myst IV: Revelation
games.description: In Myst IV: Revelation, the next chapter in the greatest adventure saga of all time, you'll travel through environments pulsing with life to unearth a treacherous scheme involving two of Myst's most sinister villains.

games.title: Nimbatus - Drone Creator

games.title: Polygon Attack

games.title: The Experiment: Escape Room

games.description: EV3 is built by real life drag racers. The fun of drag racing is driving, not just pushing buttons. In EV3 you actually drive the car using realistic variable gas pedal, steering, braking, realistic suspension and engine/torque response... It's all there.

games.description: It's a retro horror game featuring eerie black, white, and red visuals. Embark on an exciting adventure across 18 suspenseful levels while evading "The Shadow" and discovering five possible endings. It is heavily influenced by RPGs and borrows some mechanics and ideas. The result is a fascinating mixture between role playing game and a classic card collection game.

games.title: Nostradamus: The Last Prophecy
games.description: The Spiritual. The Supernatural. The Skeptical. All are touched upon in Nostradamus: The Last Prophecy. The player is immortalized as a profiler of sorts in this treasure hunt game - a brilliantly vivid historical rendition of the acclaimed quatrains of Nostradamus.

games.title: Sudden Strike 3
games.description: Experience the hit World War 2 real-time strategy game for the first time in full 3D glory, expanding on all strategic and tactical options. Command joint operations of naval, land-based and airborne units on the largest maps in the series.

games.title: Box: The Game
games.description: Box: The Game is a fun puzzle game which will challenge your brain to think in different ways. All cubes attach to each other, your goal is to match the displayed shape to continue to the next level.

games.title: Doodle Kingdom
games.description: It's time to get MEDIEVAL! From the creators of the award winning puzzle games Doodle God & Doodle Devil, comes a new fantasy brain-teaser where you can create your own Kingdom with Castles, Knights, Warlocks and Dragons! Great for gamers of ALL ages.

games.title: Luxor 3
games.description: A brave young Pharaoh, killed prematurely by a fierce sandstorm and embodied by the gods as a skillful scarab, must battle the powerful god of Chaos, Set, to free the essences of other Egyptian gods contained within colorful magical spheres.

games.title: The Cooking Game
games.description: Start The Cooking Game, learn to cook, serve and manage your own restaurants. Show your skills and feed the hungry customers!

games.title: Hexen: Deathkings of the Dark Citadel
games.description: Hexen: Deathkings of the Dark Citadel is a dark fantasy first-person shooter and expansion to Hexen: Beyond Heretic. After discovering the Chaos Sphere, you have been transported to the Realm of the Dead. Now, your only way home is blocked by the Dark Citadel.

games.title: LONN
games.description: Grab. Throw. Obliterate. Physics-driven VR where telekinesis meets cyberpunk chaos. You're an elite bounty hunter dismantling a mind-transfer cult—using swords, guns, and anything you can hurl. 8hr campaign, roguelike missions, arena battles. Total freedom. Zero limits.

games.title: Mangui
games.description: Mangui is a turn-based roguelike game inspired by spooky traditional Korean folklore. Play as one of four protagonists, unraveling the mysteries of the dark Mangui mountains. Live to tell the tale in this dangerous world filled with ghouls and monsters!

games.title: 1931: Scheherazade at the Library of Pergamum
games.description: 1931: Scheherazade at the Library of Pergamum is the latest story-driven RPG from Black Chicken Studios, inc., spinning tales of pulp adventure, exotic locations, occult horror, and romance that'll require well-honed skills.

games.title: Ceville
games.description: The mean cruel cold blooded tyrant Ceville ruthlessly rules the beautiful kingdom of Faeryanis. Or rather, he used to rule the beautiful kingdom of Faeryanis, until the brave people revolted against his regime and drove him out of the palace.

games.title: The Infinite Black
games.description: Fleet up with thousands of players in The Infinite Black -- The wildly popular online space combat and adventure game! Command massive spaceships, form powerful corporations, and battle it out in never-ending intergalactic warfare!

games.title: Wandering in Space VR
games.description: Join Wandering In Space, a unique FPS ROGUELITE SCI-FI experience built for VR. With a variety of space weapons, upgradable armory, power ups and unknown superpower, you, a soldier without any memory have to fight the mutants, cyborgs and the rebels to survive in the space of unknown...

games.title: AlternativA
games.description: Alternativa is a story that will take you to a world much different to what you'd expect in 2045. To a world destroyed by war and revolutions, a world led by an oppressive and cruel dictatorship. Classic point&click adventure game based on the original sci-fi/cyber-punk script which is composed of a number of shorter stories that...

games.title: AMOK
games.description: Protagonist of the game is investigating the disappearance of people. The investigation leads him into an old house, and then it becomes a party to the strange and dangerous events.

games.title: Armed to the Gears
games.description: Control a fully armed Mech and fight through cyberpunk cities, military bases and industrial ruins. Capture and defend territories, build turrets and structures, and wage war against powerful enemies!

games.title: Bohemian Killing
games.description: Paris, 1894. Class differences and pervasive racism finally lead to a tragedy. A year later you find yourself on trial, accused of a brutal murder. How far will you go to exonerate yourself? Will you lie? Manipulate the evidence? Frame others? Act insane? Confess? Your imagination is the limit.

games.title: Gems of the Aztecs
games.description: A dangerous journey into the ruins of an ancient city await our hero. Help him find the treasure in Gems of the Aztecs!

games.title: Naev
games.description: Naev is a game about space exploration, trade, and combat in a large and vibrant universe. Players travel the galaxy and earn money by trading, fighting, and performing missions.

games.title: Steel Fury: Kharkov 1942
games.description: Steel Fury: Kharkov 1942 is based on real-life events that took place from May 12 to 28, 1942. During a vicious German counterattack three Soviet Armies were surrounded and were forced to fighting in what has become known as the “meat grinder.”

games.title: Cross Set
games.description: Cross Set is a simple and brain-teasing new number puzzle game.

games.title: Depth of Extinction
games.description: Explore a flooded world and save humanity from a terrible threat in this turn based, tactical RPG with roguelike elements

games.title: Galaxy Reavers
games.description: This is a fun yet challenging RTS game. To survive in the vast galaxy, you need to build up your own fleet and customize your warships. You will also learn to control them efficiently in battle to defeat your enemies, conquer planets, and expand your galactic empire!

games.title: PC Creator - PC Building Simulator
games.description: Try yourself as a PC builder and build your dream PC from 200+ real components!Complete different PC building and PC repair orders to upgrade your business: build a PC from zero, install popular OS', upgrade computers, install different programs and games, fix PC parts, and much more.

games.title: Prey with Gun
games.description: Under command of a young boy to complete his plan and dig out the hidden truth and his motivation. (The English Version of this game will release soon)

games.title: Tiamat X
games.description: Featuring six levels of intense shooting action, Tiamat X is a rip-snortin tribute to the side-scrolling space shooters of yesteryear, and would be right at home blazing away on the screen of a booming, beer-stained arcade cabinet.

games.title: Crossing Guard Joe
games.description: In Monoxide City where the cars don't stop, only one man can help kids cross the street.

games.title: Gnomes Garden 2
games.description: Gnomes Garden 2 – the sequel to an exciting fantasy strategy game. Restore the magical gardens and defeat the troll queen!

games.title: Finding Nemo
games.description: Based off the 2003 feature film, Disney•Pixar's Finding Nemo, play as Marlin and Nemo in two separate major story lines!

games.title: Heroes of Dire
games.description: In Heroes of Dire, a new massively-multiplayer tactical role-playing game by Spellbook, players command squads of fighters through strategic turn-based battles to win treasure, fame, and glory for their guilds!

games.title: Racecraft
games.description: Start racing in many asynchronous events for free. Accumulate Season Points each month by competing in Championships, Tournaments and Special Events on always new circuits created by the Racing Authority, climbing to higher licenses. Check out the Premium DLC for even more!

games.title: 彗星战团
games.description: 在黑暗的时代，乘上独一无二的机动装甲，反抗统治太阳系的军工巨企。《彗星战团》是一款以科幻战争为主题的国产机战视觉小说，致力于营造独特的影视化观感。——你将成为点燃整个时代的星火！

games.title: Alpacapaca Dash
games.description: Alpacapaca Dash is an endless runner with lasers and alpacas, a fun, cute and addictive game. Try to get the highest score, the highest amount of coins, unlock all alpacas and play until you can fully restore the world!

games.title: CropDuster Supreme
games.description: Put your flatulent skills to the test in this fast-paced toot-shooting gas-passing masterpiece.

games.title: Intrude
games.description: Intrude is a first-person shooter. Your mission is to get into a long time abandoned base, suddenly taken over by some kind of private military, find your way up and destroy the source of a signal comming from the base. Collect as much data as you can to find out what they are up to.

games.title: Season Match
games.description: The story of Season Match starts when the Snow Queen has her magic mirror broken, and decides to make cold winter stay forever in the fairy-land. You will set out on a legendary journey to find the pieces of the broken mirror, put them together and beat the Snow Queen.

games.title: Star Trek: Starfleet Command Gold Edition
games.description: Dozens of missions & more than 50 ship designs put you in the captain’s chair for an amazing real-time space combat experience commanding ships from the United Federation of Planets, the Klingon Empire, the Romulan Star Empire, the Hydran Kingdom, the Gorn Confederation or the Lyran Star Empire!

games.title: Totally Unbalanced
games.description: Totally Unbalanced is a 3D platform game where you have to complete puzzles and overcome obstacles. Totally Unbalanced also features (currently) two multiplayer modes : sumo arena with 4 players and racing mode with 16 players.

games.title: Elements: Soul of Fire
games.description: The light of the world fades. Evil hearts seek the Power of the Elements - the forces which bind the universe together - thus threatening all of existence. An homage to the 8-BIT era with a charming art style.

games.title: Gloomy Eyes VR
games.description: With the voice of Colin Farrell, Gloomy Eyes narrates the story of the sun who got tired of the humans and decided to hide and never rise again. Gloomy Eyes is an animated VR-series in 6DoF & 3D real-time.

games.title: 坦克大战:共和国之辉
games.description: Real-time tank RPG game. It recreates the classic tanks of World War II and restores the shocking war scenes with fantasy World War II plots. Command your futuristic tanks across history and rekindle your war spirit with the will of iron and blood.

games.title: Cowpocalypse
games.description: Disappearing cows, strange visitors, talking trees... What is going on here...? Is the end of the world, the cowpocalypse really here? Discover the mysteries trough this puzzle filled, 2,5D, point & click style adventure game.

games.title: Go For A Punch! Saki Sanobashi
games.description: Four students find themselves trapped in the restroom of an abandoned school; the door is locked. Without a way of escaping, they can only cling to their remaining shreds of hope or come face to face with their inevitable ruin.

games.title: SickBrick
games.description: SickBrick is an action-packed science fiction first-person-shooter (FPS) with vivid graphics and fast, frantic game play. Destroy hundreds of hostile robots with a wide variety of weapons on a strange alien planet.

games.title: Space Station Tycoon
games.description: Create a thriving space station in a lost sector. Face thrilling challenges head-on, from pirate raids to asteroid impacts, as you lead your company to new heights.

games.title: Through The Fragmentation
games.description: Atmospheric first person adventure game focusing on immersion and exploration. Meet strange characters, discover secrets and try to unfold the mystery of the Fragmentation.

games.title: Epics of Distant Realm: Holy Return
games.description: Epics Of Distant Realm: Holy Return is a Turn-Based Combat and Story Sci-Fi game that delves into the mythologies of the universe, the terminal of the universe, the Planet of Destiny.

games.title: Stay Alight
games.description: Become a world savior in the new arcade game — Stay Alight®! Meet the adventurous Mr. Bulb, who will free the planet from the cartoonish microbes with your help. The green meanies have conquered the planet completely and utterly, so it’s up to Mr.

games.title: The Last Sniper VR
games.description: Travel back in time to WW2 and experience what it was like to fight as a soldier in room space Virtual Reality. The Last Sniper aims to simulate the sounds, visuals and feel of what it might have been like to be a soldier in a truly massive and horrifying war.

games.title: Dangerous High School Girls in Trouble!
games.description: "Well behaved women seldom make history." - Laurel Thatcher Ulrich This is the game where good girls get better by being bad! In the 1920s, young women had a chance to change society--by misbehaving. Gather a gang of girls. Explore. Battle petty townsfolk with quick, naughty games: Fib, Flirt, Taunt...

games.title: KAMUI
games.description: Centuries have passed since the events of RefleX and mankind has once again attained civilization. Now, ancient technology born of a twisted mind sets in motion a chain of events designed to bring divine retribution down upon mankind.

games.title: Return to Mysterious Island 2
games.description: Mina’s rescue from the end of the first game is cut dramatically short and she and primate pal Jep are left again on the mysterious island to fend for themselves! Mina needs to dress her wounds and keep safe against the local wildlife, but now she has the assistance of the player controlled Jep who can fit in smaller spaces, move deftly...

games.title: ROOT
games.description: ROOT is a cyber espionage themed hardcore stealth FPS that lets you play it how you want: whether creeping along corridors undetected or bursting into rooms to blow away all adversaries. Cyber terrorism is a dangerous profession, and risks have real consequences.

games.title: Save the Dodos
games.description: Save the Dodos! We’re all familiar with the sad tale of the charming, yet unintelligent Dodo. But now you can prevent their heart-breaking tale of extinction! Guide the dodos through 100 challenging levels and save our avian dullards from extinction.

games.title: A Magical High School Girl
games.description: "The magic beckons you." A Magical High School Girl is a magic crafting rogue-like RPG! The only weapon you possess is the magic you conjure from within. You can freely name your magic. The elemental properties and effects are generated automatically with what you typed in.

games.title: Battle Brawlers
games.description: Battle Brawlers is a fast-paced, globally served RTS game. In 1v1, 2v2 battles, only goal is to strategically place troops and flexibly cast magic spells to defeat enemy's War Gods!

games.title: Call of Cthulhu: The Wasted Land
games.description: Call of Cthulhu: The Wasted Land is a turn-based strategy/role-playing game based on the award winning Call of Cthulhu RPG. Set in the midst of World War One, the game pits your team of investigators and soldiers against an ancient enemy, one older than humanity itself...

games.title: Square n Fair
games.description: Relaxing puzzle platformer.

games.title: The Few
games.description: Take command over RAF during the WW2 history turning point, the Battle of Britain! The goal of the game is to defend Great Britain against German bombing raids.

games.title: Memento Mori
games.description: The enhanced version of Memento Mori which includes the full soundtrack.

games.title: Knights of Pen and Paper 3
games.description: Enter the new and improved world of chivalry, class warfare and off-beat pop references. Knights of Pen & Paper 3 is a true sequel to the turn-based, retro style, pixel-art adventure full of danger and saving throws you hold so dear!

games.title: Original Journey
games.description: Original Journey is a 2D hand drawn, sci-fi action-adventure with a bold hand drawn art style. Join the Ato as they embark on a mission to save their home world. Only a mysterious power source discovered on a distant planet can save them but how far will the Ato go save themselves?

games.title: Party of Sin
games.description: Take control of the Seven Deadly Sins as you forge your destiny on a quest to troll humanity.

games.title: Zotrix
games.description: Zotrix is a modern take on the classic arcade shooter. The game introduces resource trading economy and system of upgrades between number of space stations bringing the classic experience into modern generation. Aliens are attacking and Solar Division Command needs You!

games.title: J.U.R : Japan Underground Racing
games.description: Beat all opponents in career! Over 200 missions! Oldschool Style! Night street racing atmosphere! Nice and smooth drift physics! Huge amout of Tuning parts!

games.title: Dissolution
games.description: Experience a cutthroat universe ravaged by a war of extinction between humanity and AI. Fight for resources, territory and power in a sci-fi sandbox.

games.title: FIVE: Guardians of David
games.description: FIVE: Guardians of David is a Diablo-style action-RPG set in the ancient lands of Canaan. Lead and play the five heroes, battling across exotic locations filled with archaic cultures, rich characters, and powerful artifacts. Experience one of the greatest stories ever told in this 11-Act epic.

games.title: Gold Rush! Anniversary
games.description: Gold Rush! takes you back to the year 1849, when gold was discovered in California. It was certainly one of the most exciting times in American history. Gold Rush! includes the three routes tens of thousands took to the gold regions.  Become Jerrod Wilson and experience each trek as you travel from New York to California.

games.title: Switchblade
games.description: War is the new sport in Switchblade, an arena-based 5v5 vehicle action game that combines high-octane combat with an ever-shifting selection of strategic choices.

games.title: Electro Ride Prologue
games.description: Racing neon cars from the former Eastern Bloc. Start at the Berlin Wall. The first routes and quick race mode will give you a taste of the Electro Ride competition. Neon lights, superfast, unique, classic, iconic cars. Get crazy about colorful streets!

games.title: rooMaze
games.description: rooMaze is a first person hardcore roguelike with voxel graphics and procedurally generated levels! All of this is powered by Unreal Engine 4. Don't let acute-angled cubes deceive you as behind a simple visual style lies the all-consuming hardcore.

games.title: Achievement Machine
games.description: Achievement Machine is a colorful clicker game for those who wants not only to get tons of achievements in no time, but also to enjoy real gameplay and various gamemodes!

games.title: Commando Hero
games.description: Hero who wants to be a commando has to pass difficult tracks. Finish the track fast and enter the Leaderboard.

games.title: Katy and Bob: Safari Cafe
games.description: Katy and Bob: a new chapter in the adventures of Katy and Bob. Head into the safari park and grow your business!

games.title: Porcunipine
games.description: A party game / arena fighter where balding porcupines with only a single quill left fight to the death for honour, glory, and their enemies' skulls!

games.title: Save One More
games.description: Save One More is a heal'em up game about combat medic, where your task is to save lives instead of taking them

games.title: Hauntsville
games.description: You're a nameless traveler, stranded in a ghost town in the Cursed West. Use your wits, elbow grease, and the iron on your hip. Build a homestead, work the land, and survive against unspeakable monsters in this unique Western horror survival game - alone or with friends!

games.title: Rescue your chickens
games.description: This game is a story of a father who is left alone to take care of his chickens. You must use your skill to avoid all sort of forest creatures and to save all 10 chickens. Fight bosses, and be prepared for an epic finale. The game difficulty start from easy to hard making this game last for hours of fun gameplay.

games.title: Skyreach
games.description: Explore an ancient civilization lost in the clouds. Wind your way through floating mountains, hand carved columns, and relics of a time long passed. Collect crystals and time your play precisely to increase your score as you travel through the stunning environments of Skyreach.

games.title: ALONE
games.description: You have to help a guy named Yeongchul trapped inside his home, navigate the house to protect himself from suspicious person.

games.title: The USB Stick Found in the Grass
games.description: A forensic challenge – find out who the owner of the USB stick was and reconstruct their story.

games.title: Crystal Call
games.description: Run, dash, blast and slide your way through challenging environments in this fluid and fast paced first person speedrunner!

games.title: Project RPG Remastered
games.description: You wake up on a dirt road, holding on to your last memory of your family screaming for help in front of you. Now, with all odds against you, you must complete challenging and dangerous quests to gain help from the villagers of Bartrone. How far are you willing to go to find your wife and son?

games.title: Vacuum Pilot
games.description: Vacuum Pilot is a 2D speedrunning game with easy to learn but hard to master controls based on mouse movement.

games.title: Battlevoid: Sector Siege
games.description: Battlevoid: Sector Siege is an epic straight into action real-time space strategy game, in which the world has been built to deliver a lively battle field; and the action is never more than just seconds away at the start of every game.

games.title: Konung 2
games.description: The world of Konung is a unique and spacious fantasy land, that combines parts of known history with classical myths and the legends of the Chronicles, including immortal heroes, magical artefacts and ancient sorcery.

games.title: Making History: The Calm and the Storm Gold Edition
games.description: Making History Gold Edition is the expanded and updated version of the original WWII grand strategy game Making History: Calm & the Storm. Command your nation and change the course of history.

games.title: Night Trap - 25th Anniversary Edition
games.description: Night Trap tells the story of five teenage girls spending the weekend at the Martin home. As a member of the Special Control Attack Team, your job is to monitor the home and protect the girls using an intricate system of cameras and traps as it is being invaded by vampires.

games.title: Cargo 3
games.description: Cargo 3 is a futuristic action game set in science-fiction horror world, which links the best features of the genre: unusual dynamics and thrilling high intensity of the gameplay.

games.title: Elminage Gothic
games.description: From the makers of the world renowned “Wizardry Empire” titles, Starfish SD brings you the latest entry in their popular series of dungeon crawlers. Elminage Gothic, previously only available in Japanese on PlayStation® Portable, now comes to PC offering a classic old school dungeon crawling experience with a dark, gothic twist!

games.title: King's Heir: Rise to the Throne
games.description: The clash for the crown is coming! Two royal knights, Edmund and Randall Ulmer, are tricked into a conspiracy against the crown.

games.title: Numen: Contest of Heroes
games.description: Nine deities. Nine heroes. And only one champion. Mythical Greece. The land of gods, poets, heroes, but also of terrible monsters and creatures. Numen is a fully three-dimensional action RPG set in mythical Greece.

games.title: RWBY Deckbuilding Game
games.description: RWBY Deckbuilding Game is a new breed of digital card game where you build your deck to defeat an array of deadly foes, or join forces in raids to take down powerful villains. No packs or boosters to chase. Each expansion is a complete experience.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls Adventures: Redguard
games.description: ONE MAN AGAINST AN EMPIRE

games.title: Theatre of War 3: Korea
games.description: Replay the events of the first hot war of the Cold War era, the Korean War, also known as the Forgotten War. Players will be involved in two campaigns, both set in the 1950’s: the North Korean (June 25 – August 20) and the American (September 15 – October 8).

games.title: Ortus Regni
games.description: Ortus Regni is a new and novel card game inspired by the late Anglo-Saxon period of English history. The Late Anglo-Saxon era in English history is a time of warring Earls. Minor kings all, they claim whatever lands they can. All the while, the Vikings roam not just the sea, but the land.

games.title: Ultimate Sudoku Collection
games.description: The best Sudoku game on Steam.

games.title: Path of War
games.description: Design your mobile headquarters, raise a fearsome army and wreak a path of destruction across the United States in 1-to-1 scale! Wage war to expand your territory through fast-paced, intense player-vs-player combat and upgrade your base with the enemy’s loot.

games.title: Skilltree Saga
games.description: Skilltree Saga is the first Rogue-like RPG set in Aventuria - the world of The Dark Eye. Choose to play as human, elf or dwarf and battle randomly generated opponents in over 100 stages, developing a set of magical, enhanceable skills.

games.title: Strategy & Tactics: Dark Ages
games.description: Dark Ages is a tactical digital board game set in the violent world of alternate Middle Ages. Vikings against war elephants, musketeers against the Mongol cavalry, ancient phalanx legions against crusaders; the deadliest armies in history clashing in bloody war.

games.title: To End All Wars
games.description: Ageod’s To End All Wars is a grand strategy game set during World War One. Players will take control over one of the major powers that so desperately fought for control over Europe and to end all wars.

games.title: Two Brothers
games.description: Two Brothers is an Action Adventure game that features a classic Gameboy aesthetic. Roy Guarder, inventor, scientist, and philosopher, is on an expedition to discover the origins of life. This quest has brought him to "The Cursed Lands," a stretch of land so dangerous and shrouded in mystery that it hasn't been explored in over...

games.title: Crazy Machines
games.description: Turn the crank, rotate the gears, push the levers, Use the catapult, explode it, or fly it...From grilling sausages with a pulley, gears, rubberbands and a candle to firing a cannon with a basketball, these wacky brain-teasers will light up your imagination with creative and addictive fun.

games.title: Dot to Dot Puzzles
games.description: Dot To Dot Puzzles is an amusing and relaxing game for young and mature people with an amazing world of complex drawings and diverse themes. Discover what is hidden behind, connecting dots orderly. Once puzzle is solved, pictures can be customized, changing lines colors.

games.title: MareQuest: An Interactive Tail
games.description: A terrible darkness threatens a world of overwhelmingly adorable mares. Can a new cute mare with amnesia save the world or will she lose more than her memories along the way?

games.title: Music Wars Empire
games.description: Take the role of a manager or CEO of a record label, and try to make your mark on the music industry!

games.title: Redneck Rampage
games.description: Well, we crash-landed that UFO in the desert and Bubba says he wants to go home. Heck, I don't blame him 'cause there ain't no place like Hickston. But according to my map, we're gonna have to blast our way through jack o' lope farms and a riverboat as well as a brothel 'fore we get home again.

games.title: The Witch & The 66 Mushrooms
games.description: An all-new Metroidvania-style game developed using Pixel Game Maker MV! Make use of a variety of weapons as you traverse sprawling stages on a mission to take back your brother's body from the witch who stole it!

games.title: Battle Star
games.description: This is an SRPG online game, the game contains 13 chapters of the main story, along with the main story can unlock dozens of heroes. Players can adjust the hero's equipment to change the battle positioning of the hero. The gameplay is rich and varied: roguelike chess, PVP, monthly events...

games.title: On the Rain-Slick Precipice of Darkness, Episode Two
games.description: On the Rain-Slick Precipice of Darkness, Episode Two is the second installment in the RPG-adventure game series based on the web comic Penny Arcade. Whether you're a fan of the first installment or new to the series, you'll be able to pick up and play Episode Two as a standalone experience.

games.title: The Crow's Eye
games.description: In an abandoned medical university, test your intellectual might as you unravel a 20-year-old mystery in this depraved first-person puzzle adventure, doing what it takes to escape your fate as a macabre scientist's human experiment. The ends justify the means in The Crow’s Eye.

games.title: CantEscapeTheBackrooms
games.description: CantEscapeTheBackrooms is a single player horror game. Explore numerous treacherous and dangerous levels, avoid contact with evil entities, and do whatever it takes to find your way out!

games.title: Estigma [Steam Edition]
games.description: Imagine Q-Bert + Pacman but with surrealistic horror aesthetics...

games.title: Nelly Cootalot: Spoonbeaks Ahoy! HD
games.description: Nelly Cootalot is the stupidly named pirate adventurer with a heart of gold. Uncover corruption and wanton punning in this HD revival of a classic freeware adventure game.

games.title: The guard of dungeon
games.description: The Guard of Dungeon - This is the mad first-person shooter. The Unknown Alien Force (UAF) wants to enslave Our World. Only the Hero can save the Planet from UAF invaders.

games.title: AntharioN
games.description: Antharion is an epic old-school fantasy RPG that combines tactical turn-based combat with the freedom of a huge living-breathing open world.

games.title: Elven Legacy
games.description: This sequel to Fantasy Wars continues its story after banishing the archdemon. The shadows of destruction begin to loom on the horizon once a human mage uncovers a dark and powerful secret dating back to the remote past of the Elven race.

games.title: MagiCats Builder
games.description: Build your very own game world in MagiCats Builder – the ultimate sandbox platformer where only your imagination is the limit! Design levels, characters, objects, environments – anything your heart desires – using a simple visual coding engine.

games.title: Mind Games
games.description: Mind games is a great set of extremely hard brain twisting puzzles! Warning: this game is for smarties! Only one out of ten people can solve the first puzzle!

games.title: Postmortem: one must die (Extended Cut)
games.description: Narrative-adventure playing an Agent of Death who must take ONE life that could change the fate of a conflict-torn Nation

games.title: AIRHEART
games.description: Airheart is a dieselpunk airplane action rogue like game, where every colorful level is built on top of the previous one, all the way up to the stratosphere. Welcome to Granaria, a flying city in the clouds. Meet Amelia - a young pilot and fisherwoman wishing to reach the abundant world's edge.

games.title: Captain Forever Trilogy
games.description: Millions of players worldwide have flown, built, and fought their way through Captain Forever. CF Trilogy brings Captains Forever, Successor, and Impostor to Steam with a beautiful new renderer, new modules, and a reimagined world written by acclaimed novelist Cassandra Khaw.

games.title: Princess Isabella: The Rise of an Heir
games.description: Master magic to save your mom and stop the witch!

games.title: Alum
games.description: Guide Alum on his journey through the "Land of Tide". Help him discover the truth about his city, Kosmos, and the mysterious epidemic known as "The Vague". As the tale unfolds, it will keep you enthralled all the way up to its epic conclusion. Alum is an original point-and-click adventure game.

games.title: BiT Evolution
games.description: Evolve through the history of video games in this fun-filled blast from the past.

games.title: Curvatron
games.description: Curvatron is a minimalist twist on the classic snake games you played on your Nokia 3310 when you didn’t have your Gameboy around. Bring back the memories of the mindless addiction with this new way to play!

games.title: Freezeer
games.description: «Freezeer» — is a love story puzzle platformer. Kiss your girlfriend but do not freeze her. To do this, you need to melt yourself on the red block. Beware of ice blocks because they can kill you.

games.title: Gunman And The Witch
games.description: Wild West City-Builder meets Top-Down Shooter! Challenge your shooting and management skills in this 2D indie game.

games.title: Hitogata Happa
games.description: Shoot 'em up with the 3rd game in the Gundemonium Collection series.

games.title: Steno Arcade
games.description: Steno Arcade is a suite of arcade games designed to teach and drill steno fundamentals in an immersive, addictive, responsive, and interactive way.

games.title: Whateverland: Prologue
games.description: A Prologue to Whateverland, an upcoming point-n-click adventure set in a bizarrely beautiful hand-drawn world, where everyone gets what they truly deserve. Experience the beginning of the journey of Vincent, an unfortunate thief, who can either find a way out or stay trapped there forever.

games.title: Bitardia Cards: Memes of 2ch
games.description: Card games and entered the world of Bitardia. Anons full of excitement and ready to destroy anyone who will sit down with them at the table!

games.title: Burn Zombie Burn
games.description: Welcome to the char-grilled world of Burn Zombie Burn, where the best type of undead is barbequed undead. The goals are simple: keep Bruce alive, as he tries to keep Daisy alive, and get the highest score possible. Standing (well, ambling) in your way is a never ending horde of the rotting, stinking and stupid undead.

games.title: inMomentum
games.description: A minimalistic sci-fi platform racing game that challenges the players to think in both horizontal and vertical perspectives.

games.title: The Adventures of Fatman
games.description: You are Fatman - the heroic crime fighter for the city of Shadowlawn. It is up to you, then, to tear yourself away from food long enough to save the city from certain destruction...

games.title: Ablepsia
games.description: Game about a blind old man. Who includes street lights. Because the whole world is in darkness. The blind man can only stop, using the space bar. Help him to lighten the dark cities. Avoiding obstacles using the left mouse button.

games.title: Cannons-Defenders: Steam Edition
games.description: Hardcore 2D game with a fascinating and unusual mechanics, where you have to defend the base from annoying saboteurs.

games.title: F-22 Lightning 3
games.description: Mass Destruction! Use tactical nuclear weapons to level entire city regions. The most realistic weather environments ever created. Changing weather effects including: rain, snow, hail, and wind. Extreme temperatures affect flight performance. Fly it yourself or let the world's most advanced fighter do it for you!

games.title: Idol Hands
games.description: Idol Hands is a strategy game where you gradually take over the world by guiding your people and defeating other gods.

games.title: Last Days
games.description: The gods have blessed New Canaan for four hundred years, and everyone - including Sister Ginsetsu - thought it would go on forever, until the day Ginsetsu met the gods of New Canaan. Since then, the story between the maiden who calls herself a god, and the maiden who will become a god has begun.

games.title: One Wish
games.description: Сlassic indie horror for one evening. The game has no tips, you need to solve all the puzzles yourself and avoid the monster that wants to devour your soul. Therefore, you need to be very careful and attentive to escape from the nightmare.

games.title: Resilience Wave Survival
games.description: Resilience: Wave Survival is a physics based endless wave survival shooter. Explore to Search for Weapons and Ammo to help Defeat the Enemies, better find food and water too if you want to Survive for longer, but Beware of the Tripods stalking the lands.

games.title: Xotic
games.description: Rack up huge scores by shooting enemies, detonating chain reactions, and discovering secret power-ups and point multipliers

games.title: Destiny of Ancient KingdomsTM
games.description: Destiny of Ancient Kingdoms (DOAK) is a free, action MMORPG based on the legends of Norse Mythology. An epic story-line, action-packed combat and classic multiplayer roleplaying elements await strong warriors who are courageous enough to enter the New World!

games.title: Gabriel Knight: Sins of the Fathers
games.description: Gabriel Knight is the last in a long line of Shadow Hunters, those fated to fight the dark forces of the supernatural.

games.title: Diaspora Mass Exodus
games.description: Mass Exodus is a 2D/3D RPG MMO point-and-click. In Diaspora Mass Exodus you will take control of one of many types and classes of ships and make your way out into one of multiple solar systems within a large and expanding galaxy. Here you will carve out your destiny and make a name for yourself among the stars!

games.title: Fowl Space
games.description: A heroic rooster sets forth on a ridiculous space adventure to DESTROY THE SUN!

games.title: Stones Keeper: King Aurelius
games.description: Stones Keeper is a turn-based strategy game with RPG elements in which you explore a detailed fantasy world, lead the Order of the Griffin, and live through the final moments of King Aurelius

games.title: Tales of Monkey Island: Chapter 5 - Rise of the Pirate God
games.description: About Chapter One The saga begins with a heated battle involving the brave but often bumbling Mighty Pirate™ Guybrush, his beloved wife Elaine, and their nemesis, the demon pirate LeChuck. When the showdown goes up in flames, Guybrush finds himself marooned on a strange island with winds that always blow inward.

games.title: Song of Farca: Prologue
games.description: You are Isabella Song – a hacker PI. Your job is to hack cameras, phones, and computers, as well as question suspects, analyze evidence and draw conclusions. But don't forget that in Farca city, even criminals can end up victims.

games.title: Collapse: A Political Simulator
games.description: is a grand strategy game that takes place in 1992-2004. You take lead of your own Party in the face of the total devastation of one of the fictional post-Soviet states in Europe. Try to realize your (or someone else's) political dreams in the shaky arena of this dilapidated situation.

games.title: Elemental Heroes
games.description: Elemental Heroes is MMO RPG with classical turn based combat and free world PVP.

games.title: Fallen Region
games.description: Fallen Region is a third-person survival sandbox game in an open, post-apocalyptic world.

games.title: Rainbow Snake
games.description: Rainbow snake is a beautiful classic game. Eating food, snake painted in different colors. Collect a colorful snake.

games.title: Until I Have You
games.description: If you could save someone, how much of yourself would you be willing to sacrifice?Until I Have You aims to recount a thrilling story of regret, love, corruption, and things gone haywire, under the strong, vibrant neon lights of a metropolitan city that just doesn't give a damn.

games.title: Water Bears VR
games.description: Free trapped water bears by rerouting, remixing, and redirecting water flows in a sunny 3D island environment. This charming VR game will have the entire family giggling as they solve puzzles and frolic with these loveable creatures.

games.title: Winexy
games.description: Winexy is a realistic 3D rolling ball game with a simple gameplay and entertaining action.

games.title: ESport Manager
games.description: Would you like to try your hand as a manager of this e-sport? eSport Manager is a game based on the idea of e-sports competitions, especially the most popular - FPS AND MOBA.

games.title: Jet Car Stunts
games.description: Master difficult stunts, set the fastest times and let your Jet Car Stunts skills shine.

games.title: Naval Armada: Ships Battle
games.description: The Battleships sends a challenge to you! Play with friends against the enemies and win epic battles on torpedo boat destroyers, cruisers and battleships! Build your own game strategy and leave opponents no chance!

games.title: Noir Syndrome
games.description: Noir Syndrome is a procedurally generated Detective Murder-Mystery with a new story every time! Featuring slick pixel art animations and a jazzy soundtrack, the player is thrown right in to a highly stylized vision of film noir.

games.title: Getaway Island
games.description: Getaway Island is a visual novel where your decisions determine your outcome. Perhaps you'll find the love of your life, or maybe you will return home a loyal man. This decision is yours to make. Maybe being stranded isn't so bad. We hope you enjoy your stay on Getaway Island!

games.title: Guardians of Graxia
games.description: Guardians of Graxia takes on the form of a card-based board game set in a floating island environment high in the sky of the Graxia world. Releasing with four powerful Guardians that will guide your armies into battle, charge onto the battlefield by laying out your forces strategically.

games.title: New Age
games.description: New Age is a turn-based strategy-RPG with nonlinear quests, team PVP turn-based battles, coop mode and open world.

games.title: Skeet: VR Target Shooting
games.description: A VR target shooting simulator for the HTC Vive. Use one of three shotguns and shoot clay pigeons and other targets in Virtual Reality. Features Trap, Skeet, and Quickdraw modes.

games.title: Air Guardians
games.description: Air Guardians is a flight combat game set in the distant future. A world government is attempting to seal their grip on power, and an air force of advanced fighter craft is called upon to fight them. Fly through several different levels, with cut scenes between missions and in game narration.

games.title: Big Money! Deluxe
games.description: Here's your chance to strike it rich! Grab as much loot as you can before your pile of coins reaches the top of the window. If you move fast enough to fill the money meter, you'll score a moneybag. Collect enough bags, and you'll join the ranks of the rich and famous.

games.title: Brushwood Buddies
games.description: In Brushwood Buddies, an unusual puzzle game, adorable creatures will enlist your help to craft various items as they journey through forests, grasslands, and villages! Discover tons of recipes, and find clever ways to manage inventory space and resources while keeping your buddies happy.

games.title: Glass Wing
games.description: The adventure of a young, scared, but smart girl.

games.title: Insanity VR: Last Score
games.description: Insanity VR combines an immersive and intuitive locomotion system in VR, a compelling horror story and escape the room like puzzles with stealth mechanics. As the new intern at a futuristic institute for mental illnesses you get transported into the mind of a patient to reconstruct his memories.

games.title: Ion Assault
games.description: In ION ASSAULT players wield thousands of Ion Particles to blast, fry and disrupt anything on screen as you see fit! GAMEPLAY WITH A TWIST: By centering its gameplay around its unique fluid and particle physics system, ION ASSAULT adds a twist to arcade style space shooters!

games.title: Mobile Astro
games.description: Run, gun, and survive! In this twin stick arcade shooter, you'll be fighting your way through countless waves of enemies to restore maximum peace to the galaxy!

games.title: Ship Simulator: Maritime Search and Rescue
Chronicles of a Dark Lord: Episode II War of The Abyss
Castle: Never Judge a Book by its Cover
Midnight Mysteries: The Edgar Allan Poe Conspiracy
Romance of the Three Kingdoms VII with Power Up Kit
Odysseus Kosmos and his Robot Quest: Adventure Game
games.description: What do you do if you are the only one left aboard a spaceship? Your team has embarked on a mysterious expedition a few years ago, the ship’s machinery has started acting up and it seems there are ghosts wandering about. Luckily, the black hole above you doesn’t pose any problems…yet.

games.title: Red Ronin
games.description: Red Ronin is a Turn-based but fast paced dash 'n slash game where a bloodthirsty ronin and her companion bot search for revenge.

games.title: projet BLARI
games.description: Try to survive in this semi open horror game inspired by the ps1 graphic era.

games.title: Scarmonde
games.description: 8-Bit Styled dungeon-crawler wherein you assemble a party from 12 Classes to brave The Depths in search of the Dragon God's Sacred Treasures!

games.title: Stop Online - Battle of Words
games.description: Stop Online is a multiplayer battle of words game where you compete with several players aiming to challenge them on their knowledge of words, trying to be the quickest to respond in order to achieve the highest rank. The words are in your language and you will challenge players in the same language.

games.title: Temple Of Snek
games.description: A snaky tile-based puzzle dungeon adventure. Defend the temple, monch the infidels, and grow and grow ...and grow?

games.title: MoonBase Commander
games.description: Explore. Strategize. Conquer.In the far future, Mankind has nearly exhausted all of earth’s natural resources. games.title: Pirates of Everseas
games.description: Build a pirate empire & explore the open seas in this exciting strategy game!

games.title: Liveza: Death of the Earth
games.description: A global catastrophe has literally torn our planet apart, breaking Earth into many pieces. You are the survivor that explores the remains of our planet and investigates the anomalies that have settled upon it. You start out with only a single item: a broken weapon that also functions as a flashlight.

games.title: Pirates of Black Cove
games.description: Plunder your way to the top and claim the title of Pirate King. This humorous mix of adventure and strategy lets you unite pirate factions, manage strongholds, and dominate land and sea battles. Raid, recruit, and wreak havoc across the Caribbean in your quest for ultimate infamy.

games.title: PRODUCER (2021)
games.description: a ~2 hour long graphic adventure novella. Tasked with disrupting the end of the world, you explore, investigate and produce your way through a strangely familiar world.

games.title: Rocket Valley Tycoon
games.description: Enter the space-race in Rocket Valley Tycoon, a free-to-play resource management game inspired by the golden age of futurism. Build Factories and Railroads, construct Rockets and send the good people of Earth to colonize space.

games.title: Gunspell 2
games.description: Gunspell 2 is an RPG Match 3 fighting game with a strong focus on realtime PvP battles. The game features multiple opportunities to collect and combine spells, guns and powers to win in a battle.

games.title: Whateverland
games.description: Find your way out of a magical prison in this non-linear point'n'click adventure full of mini games and challenges. Get to meet the charismatic Whateverlanders, steal and deceive or be a good boy to discover all the different endings of Vincent's story.

games.title: Dad Quest
games.description: Embark on a great Dadventure in this unique comedy, story-based 2D platformer. Raise your child to become the weapon they were always meant to be.

games.title: Earth Space Colonies
games.description: Earth Space Colonies is a strategy-simulation game where you build space colonies around the Solar system. Establish a first self-sustaining colony on the Red planet with ultimate goal of terraforming Mars. Play three story campaigns all at once: terraform Mars, fight on Ceres and explore Ganymede.

games.title: Nova Blitz
games.description: Nova Blitz is a real-time, digital, card game set in a future universe ruled by five Aspects of energy: Arcane, Tech, Divine, Nature, and Chaos. Summon units, play powers, and duel in real time. Turns are simultaneous, and in combat, hidden attack and block orders let you bluff and counter-bluff your opponent.

games.title: Shadow Puppeteer
games.description: Invite a friend to explore the strange, yet beautiful world of darkness and light in Shadow Puppeteer, an award-winning, local co-op adventure.

games.title: Star Merchant
games.description: Star Merchant is a galactic trading sim where you become a space entrepreneur. Buy and sell items, fight pirates, upgrade your ship and try to meet your goal without going broke!

games.title: Town Of The Dead Life 死寂之城
games.description: 《Town Of The Dead Life》 is an independent game with the background of eschatology. Players will play the role of one of the few surviving humans in the end of the world, surviving in difficult conditions and trying to change the fate of the world.

games.title: Trolley Delayma
games.description: Top down puzzle game about manipulating the tracks to redirect the trolley to save the victims. Solve the trolley problem in various forms of tiny puzzles.

games.title: EPOCH
